gist: Channel disclaimer that it does not promote drugs, alcohol or intoxicants, that content is for information and education, and that viewers should watch with care.

Aphorisms: wealth is only what you used, a wife is one who listened to you, a husband one who understood and obeyed; otherwise we only produce children, and a child should be seen as a home and not only as offspring.

Mentions people owning two flats in Noida and four in Gurgaon never used, says beyond a limit more wealth is a curse because one forgets to enjoy it, and that after love and a wife the mission should end.
Says that once accumulation and amplifying starts it ruins life, which is where he moves to the planet topic.

hindi: जीवन के अंदर जो हमारे ग्रह चाल हमारे जीवन को चला रही है जो ग्रह ऊपर बैठे हमारे जीवन को निर्देशित कर रहे हैं चलेगी उनकी होता वही है जो यह ग्रह चाहते हैं
says: The movement of the planets runs our lives, the planets sitting above direct us, and only their will prevails, so what happens is whatever the planets want.
ambiguity: No individual planet or house is named; it is a general statement of planetary control of destiny.
classical_check: Agrees with the general Jyotish premise of graha-driven karma; classical texts also leave room for effort (purushartha), which he downplays here.

hindi: राम रजी राखा शब्द बनाए इसलिए हम बेकार में रोते रहते हैं हा ये बना दे वो बना दे क्योंकि बहुत कुछ बन गया अब और बने
says: The saying 'as Ram wills' (Ram razi rakha) was made to teach acceptance; we weep needlessly asking to be given this and that, because much has already been made for us and we keep wanting more.
ambiguity: The caption blurs the first words; the sense is taken as an acceptance proverb.
classical_check: Silent; a general fatalist attitude rather than a Jyotish rule.

gist: Says that when someone gets a small promotion he feels it should have been much bigger, because what is received always feels less.

hindi: याद रखिए एक लिमिट के अधिक अगर कुछ बन जाएगा तो दुख होगा
says: Anything that grows beyond a certain limit in a person's life will bring sorrow; he presents too much of a good thing as a source of pain.
ambiguity: The limit is not defined by any planetary measure here.
classical_check: Silent; no classical rule, a general life maxim.

hindi: बच्चा जब तक 15 साल का था बड़ा सुख देता था पति जब तक बॉयफ्रेंड था बड़ा सुख देता था पैसे जब तक आपके पास 50 लाख रुप था बहुत सुखी थे ज्यादा होने लगा अब दुख हो रहा है
says: He gives examples of the limit: a child gave joy until about 15, a husband gave joy while still a boyfriend, and money gave happiness while you had 50 lakh, but when it grows beyond that it brings sorrow.
ambiguity: The numbers 15 years and 50 lakh are illustrative, not measured.
classical_check: Silent; anecdotal.

hindi: क्योंकि आप उस चक्र भी माया के उस जंजाल में फस चुके हैं जो आपके ग्रहों के विरुद्ध जाने की तैयारी में है प्रारब्ध आपके जीवन को बांध के
says: Beyond that limit you are caught in the trap of maya, which is preparing to go against your planets, and prarabdha (destiny from past deeds) binds your life.
ambiguity: The phrase 'going against your planets' is loose; the sentence finishes in the next chunk.
classical_check: Prarabdha karma as the part of past karma shaping this life is classical doctrine.

hindi: रखता है यह ग्रह यही है कि आपका जीवन तो भैया किसी और की मर्जी से चलेगा आपकी औकात नहीं कि आप अपनी मर्जी से जीवन चला सको जितनी जल्दी यह समझ आ जाए उतना बढ़िया
says: Destiny keeps the person bound, and the planets mean that life will run by someone else's will, since you cannot run it by your own; the sooner this is understood the better.
ambiguity: Strongly worded; not every school agrees that free will has no role.
classical_check: Classical Jyotish allows effort to modify some results; this extreme fatalism goes further than the texts.

hindi: इसलिए हमें कृष्ण रथ चलाने के लिए चाहिए कृष्ण को बुलाना नहीं आता लफड़ा यह है
says: We need a Krishna to drive the chariot of life, but we do not know how to call him; this is the problem, and astrology is meant to stand in for that guide.
ambiguity: The link of Krishna and the chariot to astrology is implied by the next sentence, not said outright.
classical_check: Silent; a Mahabharata metaphor of his.

hindi: अगर यह ना आए तो समझ तो ले व्यूह की रचना कैसे करनी है तब जीवन के महाभारत को मनुष्य जीत सकता है
says: If Krishna does not come, at least understand how to arrange the battle formation (vyuha); knowing the planetary pattern lets a person plan and win the Mahabharata of life.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical view that astrology guides planning rather than replaces effort.

hindi: अन्यथा हम अंधा दौड़ रहे भैया इंक्वायरी आई है काम के लिए जा रहे होगा नहीं होगा किसे पता है और मजे में कहते हैं यार उसका तो अपने आप हो गया
says: Without understanding the pattern we run blind: an inquiry for work comes and we cannot know whether it will happen, and when something does happen people casually say it happened on its own.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Greets the audience, welcomes them and thanks everyone who joined.
Says they are taking the previous class towards completion and that a few questions come first.
A small question from last week: someone says the astrology story is nonsense, many people do nothing, and ask whether to wear stones.

hindi: उपाय कर लो यहां दान कर लो बहुतों को तो जरूरत ही नहीं है बड़ी फैक्ट बात है भाई
says: Many people have no need of remedies, stones or donations at all, and he calls this a big fact; remedies are not needed by everyone.
ambiguity: The first words belong to the audience question that precedes; his answer begins at 'many do not need at all'.
classical_check: Classical texts prescribe remedies only for afflictions, so people with no affliction need none, which agrees.

hindi: नॉनवेज मत खाओ नॉनवेज खाओ कुछ खाते हैं कुछ नहीं खाते हैं खाने वाले कहते हैं कुछ नहीं होता हम तो खा रहे हैं दूसरे कहते हैं नहीं खाना ही नहीं चाहिए हमें तो दिक्कत आ गई
says: On diet, some eat non-vegetarian food and say nothing happens to them, while others say they should not eat it and got into trouble when they did; the same rule does not work for everyone, which he treats as a sign of different destinies.
ambiguity: No health or dietary prescription is made; it only illustrates variety.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जीवन के अंदर विचित्र प्र किस्म का हिसाब किताब है जो मुन्ना है उसने कॉस्मस के द्वारा अजीब प्रारब्ध फिक्स किया सारी दुनिया भर के लोगों को वैरायटी इतनी तगड़ी है कि अंत नहीं है
says: Life runs on a strange kind of accounting, and the cosmos has fixed a different prarabdha for each person in the world, with so much variety that it never ends.
ambiguity: 'मुन्ना' is a colloquial name for God or the creator here.
classical_check: Consistent with classical karma doctrine that each birth chart is a distinct ledger.

gist: Says let us take four kinds of people out of the large crowd of the earth, the four who give the shoulder at a funeral, and that their stories are strange.

hindi: एक व्यक्ति ऐसा है यह वाला व्यक्ति कुछ भी खाता है कुछ भी नहीं खाता है कैसे मर्जी रहता है दारू पीता है नहीं पीता है अयाशी करता है टाइम ब टाइम सोता है कुछ भी करता है इसके ग्रह प्रारब्ध ऐसा है
says: The first type is a person who eats or skips anything, drinks or not, indulges, sleeps at odd times and does as he likes, and he is like that because his planets and prarabdha are such that he is protected.
ambiguity: This is a description, not a recommendation to follow his lifestyle.
classical_check: Silent; a character type of his own.

hindi: जिसकी हम बात ये करेंगे कि भाई ग्रह ही अच्छे होंगे किस्मत अच्छी होगी ये ऐसा है कि इस बे बे को ना खाने पीने की परवाह है ना कुछ और लेकिन बॉडी फिट है यह बीमारी नहीं पड़ा
says: For the first type he says his planets must be good and his luck good: he has no care about food or drink, yet his body is fit and he does not fall ill.
ambiguity: A health observation by the speaker, not a medical claim; no specific planet is named.
classical_check: Strong lagna and lagna lord give good health in classical Jyotish, which fits the idea but is not stated here.

hindi: यह गालियां बगता है अबे डॉक्टर के पास जाते हो साले मरी मरे वहम में तुम पागल होते रहते हो हमें देखो अब भाई प्रकृति ने चुना है इसके ग्रह ही ऐसे हैं इसके भाग्य ही ऐसा
says: The first type scolds others for running to doctors out of imaginary fears and says look at me, but he does not realise that nature chose him and that his planets and his fortune are simply like this.
ambiguity: The abuse he hurls is mimicry, not a claim of his own.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: भाई इससे कुछ हो ही नहीं रहा ना इसे कोई पत्थर पहनने की जरूरत है ना इसे कोई तोता मैने को कुछ खिलाना ना गौ माता की सेवा चाहिए इसे कुछ चाहिए ही नहीं अब यह हो गया घोर नास्तिक मजे में चल रहा है
says: Nothing goes wrong for the first type, so he needs no gemstone, no feeding of birds, no cow service, nothing at all; he becomes a firm atheist who is doing fine, which shows remedies are not for everyone.
ambiguity: 'तोता मैना' read as feeding parrots and mynahs, i.e. birds.
classical_check: Agrees that remedies are for afflicted charts; strong charts need none.

hindi: अब एक सेक्शन ये हो गया दूसरे सेक्शन का एक व्यक्ति यह हो गया इसके जीवन के अंदर भैया यह पानी भी पानी भी नहीं खा सकता मतलब पानी लगे शरीर को तो शरीर बीमार है
says: The second type is a person who cannot even tolerate water without his body getting sick; his body falls ill at the slightest thing, which marks him as the opposite of the first type.
ambiguity: The health picture is an exaggeration to show contrast, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent; weak lagna or lagna lord is the classical link to poor health, not stated here.

hindi: अब ये बेस्ट योग अभ्यास करता है आसन करता है जोशियां के पास जाता है टीले वाले बाबा के पास जाता है यह कहता है भाई मैंने यह किया यह किया भाई तब मैं ठीक हूं
says: The second type does the best yoga practice and asanas, visits astrologers (Joshi) and the hill baba, and says he stays fine only because of all he does; his health depends on constant effort.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब इसके प्रारब्ध में ऐसा लिखा है कि भैया तूने बहुतों का नोज खा रखा होगा पहले बांट ऐसा हो सकता है तो पहले वो देगा तब इसको सदा से मुक्ति मिलेगी
says: For the second type his prarabdha says that in the past he must have taken from many people (the word is garbled) and may have to give it back first, and only after he gives will he get lasting release from his trouble.
ambiguity: 'नोज' and 'बांट' are garbled; the sense is a karmic debt to be repaid, but the exact thing taken is unclear.
classical_check: Karmic debt repaid before relief matches the classical idea of rina-anubandha.

gist: Says the second type finally goes to the doctor uncle and declares that the doctor is God, while he himself says he is God.

hindi: तीसरा बंदा आ गया इस बंदे की समस्या क्या है यह वहम का ही मारा है इसने सारी जिंदगी यही कैलकुलेशन में लगा दिया भैया जब तक तो मैं यह पत्थर ना पहनू जब तक तो वो दान ना करो तब तक मेरी लाइफ ठीक नहीं होगी
says: The third type is a victim of doubt who spends his whole life calculating that his life will not be fine unless he wears a certain stone or makes a certain donation.
classical_check: Silent; a critique of remedy-dependence, not a classical rule.

hindi: अब इसका बिलीफ सिस्टम ऐसा क्रिएट हो गया है कि इसका यही चल रहा है बड़ी अजीब गरीब स्थिति है इसके जीवन के अंदर य इसी चक्कर में लगा भैया हम तो चार धाम जाएंगे हम तो राम का नाम ले हम तो भाई गुरुद्वारे की परिक्रमा करेंगे हमें तो चलिया रखे बिना चैन नहीं
says: The third type's belief system has become such that he is stuck in it: he insists on Char Dham, chanting Ram's name, circling the gurudwara and keeping a chaliya vow, and cannot rest without these.
ambiguity: 'चलिया' is read as the 40-day chaliya vow; the caption is a little garbled.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says to think about how strange these kinds of people are, before the fourth type.

hindi: और एक व्यक्ति ऐसा है जो जीवन के ऐसे सत्य को जान जाता है भैया सब ड्रामा है सब ड्रामा है कोई कैसा होना कोई कैसा
says: The fourth type is a person who realises the truth of life that all of it is drama, with each person made to be one way or another, and so he stays unattached.
classical_check: Echoes the vedantic view of life as lila or play; not a Jyotish rule.

hindi: ऊपर अंतरिक्ष ने चुन लिया कि भैया एक व्यक्ति अब सन 2025 के अंदर करोड़ों अरबपति बनेगा उदाहरण की बात उसने एलन मस्क नाम का एक बंदा चुन लिया
says: Space (the cosmos) above chooses who will become, say in 2025, a billionaire among crores of people, and as an example it chose a man called Elon Musk; the sentence cuts off and carries no stated rule or chart reading.
ambiguity: The year 2025 and the example are illustrative; the chunk ends mid-sentence.
classical_check: Silent; the cosmos choosing individuals is a statement of fate, not a technique.

hindi: जकरबर्ग फिर ऐसे थे बिल गेट्स ऐसे बदल रहे हैं वह चुन लिया गया है अब उसको क्या है उसका लिखा ही ऐसा है कि होना यही है अब उसकी जिंदगी में सब कुछ आ रहा है
says: Using Zuckerberg and Bill Gates as examples, he says such people are 'selected' by destiny: their written fate is that it will happen, so success flows into their lives regardless of what they do.
ambiguity: No chart factor named; it is a general fatalism claim, not a specific yoga.
classical_check: Classical texts agree that the birth chart shows promised fortune (prarabdha), but name specific yogas, which he does not here.

hindi: तो वह कोई चीज कर रहा है ना कोई मंत्र जाप कर रहा है ना लक्ष्मी मैया की पूजा आरती कुछ नहीं कर रहा है वो वह चुना गया है उसने क्या किया है उसे खुद नहीं पता
says: He claims such a person does no mantra chanting and no Lakshmi worship, yet receives wealth; the person does not even know what he did to deserve it, so rituals are not the cause of the rise.
ambiguity: Whether he means remedies are useless or only that fortune precedes them is not clear.
classical_check: Differs from remedial texts that promise results from worship; consistent with the karma-phala doctrine that strong yogas fructify unaided.

gist: Story of Zuckerberg's company: after the election and buying X it crashed to about 44 million, then recovered to 12 to 19 billion; figures garbled in captions.

hindi: यह विचित्र खेल है कर क्या रहा है वो वो सिर्फ हिल रहा है डुल रहा है और उसको परमात्मा करके दे रहा है
says: He calls it a strange game: the person only moves about while the Supreme (Paramatma) keeps giving, so outcomes are delivered by destiny and not earned by his visible efforts.
ambiguity: Paramatma is used in a general sense, not as a planet.
classical_check: Silent on any specific rule; it is a philosophical statement.

hindi: ऐसे ही जकरबर्ग का टाइम पीछे आया उस पर केसेस बन गए ऐसे ही पंगे किसी और के चले
says: In the same way, when Zuckerberg's time turned bad, legal cases were filed against him; he says troubles like this come to anyone when their period turns adverse.
ambiguity: 'Time' is not tied to a named dasha or transit; could be either.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit that adverse periods bring litigation (6th/12th house activations), but no rule is named.

hindi: यही लाइफ है हम खेल रहे हैं और हमें कोई खिला रहा है और यह गृह चाल को समझ लेने के पश्चात ही हम जान सकते हैं
says: Life is a play in which we think we play but are being played by something else; only by understanding the movement of the planets can we know this.
classical_check: Fits the classical view of grahas as agents of karma; no technique specified.

hindi: भैया इस ड्रामे से निकलना है तो कैसे निकलना है बड़ा संयम चाहिए बड़ा पेशेंस चाहिए लेकिन होता ही नहीं क्योंकि कहीं कोई समझाने बताने वाला हमारे बटन ऑन
says: To step out of this drama one needs great restraint and patience, but it rarely happens because nobody switches on our button, meaning nobody explains it to us.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the chunk boundary and finishes in the next chunk.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: नहीं करता भैया शांति रख ले पेशेंस रखें उसी अनुसार उसी प्रकार के उपाय किए जाते हैं
says: Nobody tells people to keep peace and patience, and the remedies given are matched to that same need, so the right remedy depends on what kind of person and problem it is.
ambiguity: Continuation of the previous sentence from the earlier chunk.
classical_check: Classical upaya texts also tailor remedy to the afflicted planet; consistent.

hindi: उपाय का मतलब क्या है ग्रह को चढ़ावा कोई व्यक्ति अपने आप को चढ़ावा देता है कोई डॉक्टर को चढ़ावा देता है कोई बाबा को चढ़ावा देता है
says: He defines a remedy (upaya) as an offering to the planet, and notes that people instead make their offering to themselves, to a doctor, or to a baba, so the offering lands in different places.
ambiguity: Offering here means gift or donation, not only puja.
classical_check: Consistent with dana as the classical graha-shanti method.

gist: Garbled caption: something like 'everyone goes for one... brother, I have nothing of my own'; cannot tell what was said.

hindi: यह आपकी रिलाइजेशन के ऊपर है यह इसलिए इतना जरूरी है क्योंकि हर किस्म के व्यक्ति मिलेंगे आपको
says: Whether a remedy is needed rests on your own realization, which matters because an astrologer will meet every type of person and must not treat them all alike.
ambiguity: 'Realization' is not defined further.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कई चीजों में जरूरत ही नहीं है जो जो जीवन के क्षेत्र में आपका मन मचलता है कि यह दे दो यह मिल जाता ऐसा हो जाता उस उस चक्कर में आप ज्योतिषी डॉक्टर के पास जाते हैं अन्यथा तो ठीक ही है
says: In many areas of life no remedy is needed; people go to astrologers and doctors only where their mind craves something more, and otherwise things are fine, so there is no need to wander about.
classical_check: Silent; a counselling attitude, not a chart rule.

hindi: सबसे पहले यह समझना जरूरी है कि सबसे बड़ी पावर ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस है इससे बड़ी कोई पावर नहीं
says: First thing to grasp: the greatest power is human consciousness, and no planet or ritual is bigger than it.
classical_check: Differs from a strictly deterministic reading of grahas; closer to the Vedantic view.

hindi: जो हमारे शरीर के अंदर 4 प्रत ह्यूमन कॉन्शसनेस चल रही है उसके बाद 12 पर भाग्य का खेल है जो हम जन्मपत्री के द्वारा
says: He splits what runs a life into percentages: roughly 4 percent is human consciousness working inside the body, and 12 percent is the game of fate, which is what we read from the birth chart.
ambiguity: Captions say '4 प्रत' and '4 पर'; likely 4 percent, but the number may be garbled. Percentages do not sum to 100, so the base is unclear.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own scheme.

hindi: निर्धारित करते हैं और 6 पर आपकी अल्फा ब्रेन ही आपको ज्ञान दे सकती है जो समझ में भी आएगा
says: The birth chart fixes the fate part, and a further 6 percent belongs to the alpha brain, which alone can give you knowledge that you will actually understand.
ambiguity: The 6 percent figure may be a caption error; continues the 4 / 12 / 6 split.
classical_check: Silent; not from a classical text.

gist: Remark that otherwise this is a long crowd of confusion.

hindi: संसार चलता रहेगा संसार का अर्थ है निरंतर चलने वाला कभी ना रुकने वाला
says: He explains the word samsara as that which keeps moving continuously and never stops, so the world's cycle of ups and downs goes on regardless.
classical_check: Agrees with the usual etymology of samsara.

hindi: आप कहीं प्रेम करेंगे अब लड़ाई होनी है फिर लड़ाई करेंगे फिर प्रेम अभी आपके ग्रह अच्छे आएंगे सितारे बुलंदी पर होंगे फिर बुरे आएंगे फिर गर्दिश में आ जाओ
says: Life alternates between love and quarrel, and between good planetary periods when stars are high and bad periods when they are in decline; this cycle is the normal pattern of any chart.
ambiguity: Not clear whether he means dasha or transit cycles.
classical_check: Consistent with the classical idea of alternating favourable and unfavourable dashas.

hindi: यही खेल चलना है इसलिए यह गांठ बांध लो यह लीला है यह ड्रामा है जब तक यह समझोगे नहीं आप इसी उधेड़बुन में लगोगे
says: Tie this in a knot in your mind: it is all leela, a drama; until you grasp that, you will stay stuck in the churn of wanting good times and fearing bad ones.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उपाय का फायदा क्या है कोई हम उपाय की जो बात करते हैं पहला फायदा यह उपाय का कि हमें उसके द्वारा परमानेंसी मिल जाती है किसी चीज की
says: Asked what a remedy gains you, he gives the first benefit as permanence or stability: a remedy gives staying power to some area of life, not a one-time fix.
ambiguity: 'Permanence of something' is left unspecified.
classical_check: Classical texts speak of shanti reducing malefic force rather than permanence; his framing is his own.

hindi: बादाम खाने का क्या फायदा है स्वस्थ व्यक्ति को कोई फायदा नहीं है बॉडी उसका मल बना देगी लेकिन अगर उसको महीने के 15 दिन में बीमार होना है और वह बादाम खा रहा है
says: Almond analogy: a healthy person gains nothing from almonds, the body just excretes them, but someone destined to fall ill for 15 days a month who eats them in good days is stocking up reserve.
ambiguity: Analogy about remedies; health example is only an illustration, not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Silent; analogy of his own.

hindi: अच्छे दिनों में तो उसको ला आदत पड़ी हुई है तो उन 15 दिनों के अंदर बादाम उसको होल्ड कर लेगा संभाल लेगा इसलिए अच्छा भोजन करते हैं हम लगातार इसलिए अच्छे उपाय की बात करते रहो
says: Remedies done in good periods act like stored nutrition that holds you up when the bad 15 days arrive, so keep doing good remedies continuously, as we keep eating good food.
classical_check: Differs from the classical practice of doing shanti mainly when the afflicting dasha is running.

hindi: अच्छा उपाय कौन सा है जिस उपाय को करने के बाद आराम आया मेरे पास क्रोसिन
says: His test of a good remedy: the one after which relief actually came, and he starts the Crocin comparison to illustrate it.
ambiguity: Sentence continues in the next chunk.
classical_check: Empirical test not found in classical texts.

hindi: है क्यों भैया बुखार के टाइम खाके देखी थी आराम हुआ है तो आप जो उपाय करते हैं उससे स्वयं जज जजमेंट करें
says: You keep Crocin at home because you once tried it during a fever and it helped; likewise judge the results of your own remedy yourself and keep what gave you relief.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जजमेंट कितने दिन में करें 40 दिन का एक मोटा तरीका लिया जाता है 43 दिन होते हैं वैसे इसके पीछे साइंस है
says: To judge a remedy, a rough rule is to wait about 40 days (he adds that it is really 43 days), and he says there is a science behind that period.
ambiguity: He says 40 and then 43 days; the number is inconsistent and may be caption noise. Mandala of 40/41/43 days is common in tradition.
classical_check: Agrees with the common 40-day (mandala) period for sadhana; the 43 figure is not standard.

hindi: वो लिया जाता है कि आपने इतना कर लिया 43 हफ्ते कर लिया 43 दिन कर लिया चलो चार बार में भी आ सकता है आराम
says: The period is taken as how long you have done it, and he says relief might even come within four rounds; the 43 weeks versus 43 days wording is unclear.
ambiguity: '43 weeks' versus '43 days' and 'four times' are garbled and contradictory.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सबको जरूरी नहीं है कि एंटीबायोटिक पांच दिन खाना है कोई तीन दिन में भी ठीक होता है कोई एक गोली से भी होता है आपको जैसा खुद महसूस हो तो यह करो
says: Duration differs by person, like antibiotics where some need five days, some three, some a single tablet; so let your own experience decide how long to continue the remedy.
ambiguity: Medical example is only an analogy.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यह सोच लेना अरे नहीं नहीं उपाय भाई दान ही तो कर रहे हैं अच्छा ही तो कर रहे हैं यार इससे नुकसान नहीं होता होता है
says: He warns against the thought that charity is always good and cannot harm; he says a remedy such as donation can in fact cause harm.
classical_check: Agrees with classical caution that giving a malefic's articles can strengthen it.

hindi: ज्यादा घी से भी नुकसान होता है बादाम से भी होता है अधिक मीठा खाने से भी नुकसान होता है
says: Too much of a good thing hurts: excess ghee, almonds or sweets all harm, and in the same way excess or wrong remedy harms.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आप जब तक जान ना ले कि कौन सा दान करना है जो आपके प्लेनेट के लिए सही है आपके शरीर में पोटेशियम बढ़ाना है कि सोडियम बढ़ाना है आपको क्लोराइड कैल्शियम चाहिए क्या चाहिए ये देखना है
says: Until you know which donation fits your planet you should not donate, just as you must know whether the body needs potassium, sodium, chloride or calcium before supplementing.
cells_derived_method: Which donation is right depends on which planet is afflicted and its house and sign; he does not give the mapping here.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a Mercury-ruled sign in the 6th house would point to a Mercury-type donation if Mercury is the afflicted planet; not said by him.
Derived: a Saturn-ruled sign in the 10th house points to a Saturn-type donation; not said by him.

ambiguity: The body-mineral analogy is only illustrative.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical rule that each planet has its own dana articles.

hindi: विटामिन डी की गोली खाते रहो ऐसी बहुत अच्छी है खत्म कर देगी नष्ट बॉडी बढ़ गया टॉक्सिक हो जाता है
says: Even a good thing like vitamin D tablets, taken without need, turns toxic in the body; he uses this to show that a remedy taken blindly can wreck you.
ambiguity: Medical analogy only; not a medical claim to be used by the software.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसीलिए कोई भी उपाय जाने बिना करना मूर्खता है इससे अच्छा कुछ करो मत
says: His conclusion: doing any remedy without knowing what it does is foolishness, and it is better to do nothing at all.
ambiguity: Sentence crosses into the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees with the classical warning against unguided remedies.

hindi: कुछ नहीं करने से आप 4 पर को एक्टिवेट करते हैं इसकी बात भी हम करेंगे
says: By doing nothing you activate the 4 percent, the human-consciousness part, and he promises to discuss this later.
ambiguity: The 4 percent probably refers to the consciousness share stated earlier; caption reads '4 पर'.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Moves on: returns to the last class and the point where he left off.
Points at the chart boxes: first, seventh, tenth, fourth houses, and says the ninth is the one under discussion, continuing from last class.

hindi: यह न भाव नौवा भाव भगवान के मंदिर का भाव है भगवान कैसा जिस जिस के धर्म में जो जो जैसा जैसा भगवान है
says: The 9th house is the house of God's temple, where God means whatever deity each person's own religion holds, so it is not tied to one faith.
cells_derived_method: The 9th house meaning of faith and temple is coloured by the sign and its lord: a fire sign shows devotion through ritual or rigour, a water sign through emotion, an air sign through study.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter-ruled sign on the 9th suggests formal, scripture-based religion and guru reverence; not said by him.
Derived: Mars/Ketu-ruled water sign on the 9th suggests intense, secret or tantric-leaning faith; not said by him.
Derived: Mercury-ruled air sign on the 9th suggests a questioning, study-driven approach to belief; not said by him.

classical_check: Agrees: classical texts give the 9th house to dharma, temples and deities.

hindi: भगवान कौन यार जो अनजाने में मदद कर देता है पता नहीं क्या होता है कैसे होता है बस कृपा का खेला है सारा हम कृपा पर जीते हैं कृपा नहीं मिलती इसलिए रोते रहते हैं
says: He defines God as the one who helps without our knowing how, purely through grace; we live on grace, and people cry because they are not receiving it.
ambiguity: Grace is linked to the 9th house by context but not stated outright in this sentence.
classical_check: Consistent with 9th house as bhagya and grace.

hindi: तो नौवे भाव की कृपा लेने के लिए हम नौवें भाव के ही स्थान पर दान करते हैं हमारा स्थान गुरुद्वारा है तो हमारा नौवा गुरुद्वारा हो गया मंदिर है तो मंदिर हो गया टीले वा बाबा है तो वहां हो गया यानी कि धर्म स्थान
says: To draw grace from the 9th house, donate at the place belonging to the 9th house, meaning your own place of worship: a gurudwara, temple, or a baba's mound, i.e. any dharma sthan.
cells_derived_method: The kind of dharma place to donate at may follow the person's faith, and the donation article follows the 9th-house sign's lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars-ruled sign on the 9th would suggest donating at a Hanuman or similar shrine, with Mars articles; not said by him.
Derived: Jupiter-ruled sign on the 9th would suggest a guru's ashram or gurudwara with Jupiter articles; not said by him.

ambiguity: Whether the article donated also follows the planet is covered later.
classical_check: Silent on house-wise donation sites; it is a Lal Kitab style idea.

hindi: यहां पर 12वां घर में अनजान को दिया जाता है यह पुत्र को दिया जाएगा
says: For the 12th house, gifts are given to an unknown person, a stranger; and he starts naming other houses by recipient, saying this one goes to the son.
cells_derived_method: Who counts as a stranger and what to give follows the sign on the 12th and its lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter-ruled sign on the 12th suggests giving to unknown renunciates or institutions; not said by him.
Derived: Mercury-ruled sign on the 12th suggests giving books or stationery to unknown students; not said by him.

ambiguity: 'यह पुत्र को' - which house goes with the son is not stated here (5th by classical logic).
classical_check: Agrees that the 12th relates to strangers, foreign and loss; son is the 5th house classically.

hindi: या पति को या पत्नी को ये ससुराल को यह शत्रु को ये माता को रिश्तेदारों को यह भाई बहन ऐसे ऐसे चलता है
says: He continues the list of recipients by house: spouse, in-laws, enemy, mother, relatives, brothers and sisters, meaning each house's gift is given to its own kind of person.
cells_derived_method: Mapping by classical house topics: 7th spouse, 6th enemy, 4th mother, 3rd siblings, 8th in-laws' side, 11th friends and elder siblings.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus-ruled sign on the 7th suggests the gift goes to the spouse, a Venus article such as perfume or clothes; not said by him.
Derived: Sun-ruled sign on the 3rd suggests a gift to brothers or sisters of Sun-type, like wheat items; not said by him.

ambiguity: He does not say which house maps to which person; the mapping here is from classical house topics.
classical_check: The person-to-house mapping follows classical karakas, mostly agreeing.

hindi: आप स्वयं को क्या दे रहे हैं आपको हर समय हर साल अपने जीवन में स्वयं को गिफ्ट करना चाहिए
says: The first house, yourself, also needs a gift: every year in life you should give yourself a present, as self is one of the recipients in the house-wise scheme.
cells_derived_method: Type of self-gift follows the sign on the lagna and its lord.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus-ruled lagna suggests a Venus-type self-gift such as clothing or fragrance; not said by him.
Derived: Saturn-ruled lagna suggests a practical or tool-type gift; not said by him.

ambiguity: The 1st house is implied by 'self' but the sentence itself does not name it.
classical_check: Silent; not found in classical texts.

hindi: जो मैं हूं खुद यह स्वयं वाला मैं हूं दूसरा 4 पर वाला नहीं यहां पर ये मैं हूं यहां पर जो राशि है ये एक नंबर राशि है मंगल
says: The 'I' in the first house is the bodily self, not the second 'I' of consciousness; in his example the sign here is number one, Aries, ruled by Mars.
ambiguity: Sign number 1 may be a demo chart's lagna, not a general rule; 'second 4 percent I' refers to the consciousness described earlier.
classical_check: Agrees that the 1st house is self and Aries is the first sign ruled by Mars.

hindi: खुद को मीठा गिफ्ट करना चाहिए इसको बाद में करेंगे
says: For the Aries first house with Mars, he says gift yourself something sweet, and defers the full discussion to later.
cells_derived_method: The self-gift would change with the lagna sign; a Venus-ruled lagna may prefer a sweet or luxury item, a Saturn-ruled lagna a plain practical item.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus-ruled lagna: a sweet or perfume as self-gift would match Venus; not said by him.
Derived: Moon-ruled lagna: milk-based sweet or a white item; not said by him.

ambiguity: The caption puts Mars right before the sweet gift, so linking sweet to Mars is inferred from sequence.
classical_check: Sweets are not a standard Mars remedy classically (red lentil and jaggery-type items are); mild difference.

gist: Garbled caption about applying something and leaving it, then 'keep telling, I judge'; cannot tell the meaning.
Imagined question of a listener: what should I gift myself, how can I be happy.

hindi: अब पहले भगवान को पार्टी कर ले मक्खन लगा लिया जाए
says: First please God by offering to the 9th house and buttering him up, meaning devotion at the dharma place is done before the other gifts are considered.
ambiguity: Tone is humorous; 'party' and 'butter' are colloquial for appeasing.
classical_check: Silent on order of remedies.

gist: Pun on 'Bapu' as harmful to health, and a joke about the God who beats us and makes our hair fall out.
Navigation: in the 9th house the first five signs are done, the sixth sign comes next.
Says the sign cannot be done like that and moves on to sign number six.
Garbled caption with music noise and filler such as 'I love it'; no astrology content recoverable.

hindi: छ नंबर छ नंबर जो राशि है वो राहु की राशि है
says: Sign number six, Virgo, is described as Rahu's sign in his twelve-planet scheme.
cells_derived_method: Rahu's rulership of Virgo gives Rahu-type results in whichever house Virgo falls, so a Virgo lagna or a Virgo on the 8th reads differently from Virgo on the 6th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo in the 6th house puts Rahu-ruled sign in the house of service and disease; not said by him.
Derived: Virgo in the 12th gives a Rahu-flavoured house of loss and foreign lands; not said by him.

ambiguity: Numbering assumed Aries=1 so six is Virgo; he did say six is the sign, and the house being discussed is the 9th.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Virgo only to Mercury; a few later schools treat Rahu as co-lord.

hindi: यह बहुत बड़ा लफड़ा है कि भैया राशि बुध की होती है यह छह नंबर बुध और राहु एक प्रकार से भाई एक दूसरे के मित्र हैं
says: He admits a complication: the sixth sign is normally Mercury's, but Mercury and Rahu are like brothers and friends, which is how he justifies giving the sign to both.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu treats Mercury as a friend (Rahu friends: Mercury, Venus, Saturn); shared lordship itself is his own scheme.

hindi: राहु 12 ही ग्रह 12 ही भाव है 12 ही राशिया है 12 ही महीने हैं
says: He stresses the number twelve everywhere: twelve planets, twelve houses, twelve signs and twelve months, which supports his scheme of twelve planets with Rahu as the sixth sign's lord.
ambiguity: Twelve planets include the outer three, per his scheme.
classical_check: Differs: classical tradition has nine grahas, not twelve.

hindi: सूर्यवंशी राम सूर्य के द्वारा चले इसलिए बड़े मर्यादित रहे 12 महीने वो सूर्य से चलते हैं इसलिए राम को मर्यादा पुरुषोत्तम कहते हैं
says: Ram of the solar dynasty ran on the Sun, and since the twelve months run by the Sun he stayed disciplined; hence he is called Maryada Purushottam, the best of men in conduct.
ambiguity: Mythological illustration of Sun as discipline; not a chart rule.
classical_check: Agrees that Ram is of the Surya vamsha; the link of Sun to maryada is his own.

hindi: कृष्ण 16 कला संपूर्ण है ये कृष्ण चंदा मामा है इसलिए कृष्ण हर प्रकार के कार्य करते हैं हर प्रकार की मर्यादा अ मर्यादा सबको लाइसेंस देते हैं
says: Krishna is complete in sixteen kalas, he is identified with the Moon, and so does every kind of act, giving licence to both proper and improper conduct; the Moon stands for full range and flexibility.
ambiguity: Mythological illustration only.
classical_check: Agrees that Krishna is shown as sixteen-kala and Chandravamshi; the contrast with Ram (twelve kalas, Sun) is traditional.

hindi: छ नंबर राहु का है मर्यादा है यह छह नंबर राहु पकड़ के चलता है कन्या राशि है ये
says: Number six is Rahu's, connected with boundaries and discipline in his telling, and Rahu holds the sixth sign, which is Virgo.
ambiguity: Linking Rahu with maryada seems to contradict his Ram-and-Sun story, so the meaning of 'maryada' here is unclear.
classical_check: Differs from classical Rahu as boundary-breaker.

hindi: यहां पर जब छ नंबर राशि होती है तो राहु का जो जो समान होता है सारा का सारा ज्ञान सीक्रेट सर्विस साधु जो साधु फकीर
says: When the sixth sign falls on the 9th house, Rahu's things come in: knowledge, secret service, and wandering sadhus and fakirs.
cells_derived_method: Virgo on the 9th gives these Rahu themes to dharma and fortune; other signs on the 9th would change the flavour by their lord's nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter-ruled 9th gives orthodox teachers and gurus, not the wandering unorthodox figures of Rahu; not said by him.
Derived: Saturn/Rahu-flavoured air sign on the 9th would favour technology, occult or unconventional spirituality; not said by him.

ambiguity: House 9 is taken from the running context (he is in the 9th house, sixth sign), not said in this sentence.
classical_check: Silent on Virgo in the 9th giving fakirs; Rahu as secret knowledge is classical.

hindi: घूमते रहते हैं केतु भी वही है ये ये घूमते रहते हैं मुंडी सिर्फ मुंडी
says: These sadhus and fakirs keep wandering; Ketu is the same body of the story, and what moves around is just a head, which is how he pictures Rahu.
ambiguity: 'Ketu also the same' is unclear; probably that Ketu is the other half of the same demon.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is the head and Ketu the body of the Samudra-manthan demon, though classically Ketu is the headless one.

hindi: अगर आपके घर के अंदर एक हीटर है और उसके अंदर तार लगी हुई है तो उस तार का जो मुंह जो प्लग है जो स्विच बोर्ड के अंदर जाता है वो राहु है और जो तार है वो केतु है वो पूंछ है उसकी
says: Heater analogy: the plug that goes into the switchboard is Rahu, the head, and the wire is Ketu, the tail.
classical_check: Silent; a modern analogy of the head/tail image.

hindi: राहु चाय है चाय पत्ती राहु नशा है ज्ञान का नशा है मोक्ष का नशा है प्रेम का नशा नशा प्रेम नहीं है
says: Rahu is tea leaf and tea, and Rahu is intoxication in every form: the intoxication of knowledge, of liberation, of love; the high itself, not the love.
cells_derived_method: The kind of intoxication Rahu brings depends on the house and sign it occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in 5th in Gemini gives an obsessive thirst for learning and ideas; not said by him.
Derived: Rahu in 7th in Libra gives infatuation in relationships; not said by him.
Derived: Rahu in 12th in Pisces gives escapist or spiritual intoxication; not said by him.

classical_check: Agrees that Rahu rules intoxicants, obsession and illusion.

hindi: सिगरेट के द्वारा जो नशा है वो राहु है सिगरेट केतु है धुआ धुआ निकालती है टोबैको उसके अंदर मंगल है

hindi: राहु को यदि आपने डाउन करना है पर करना क्यों है हो सकता है नुकसान हो जाए तो राहु के द्वारा नुकसान भी हो सकता है

hindi: इस राहु के चाय पीने से कॉफी पीने से ऑटोमेटिक हमारे शरीर का वाटर कंटेंट कम होता है

hindi: ऐसे मंगल आप मंगल दे सकते हो यहां चीनी देते हो मंगल आप यहां देते हो तो शुगर दे दी मान लो मीठा
says: In the same chart, Mars's items are allowed: you can give sugar or sweet as Mars's donation at this place.
cells_derived_method: Mars's donation is safe when Mars is not debilitated or afflicted in the sign; in Cancer, where Mars is debilitated, it would be doubtful.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars debilitated in Cancer on the 9th would make a Mars donation less safe; not said by him.
Derived: Mars exalted in Capricorn on the 9th would make a Mars donation strong; not said by him.

ambiguity: Calling sugar a Mars item is his own assignment.
classical_check: Differs: classical Mars items are red lentil, red cloth and jaggery; sugar is more a Venus item.

hindi: मीठे में आप यहां पर सफेद मीठा नहीं दे सकते क्योंकि सफेद रंग आ जाएगा तो चंद्रमा और शुक्र के सम्मेलन में आ जाएगा और यहां शुक्र नीच का है
says: Among sweets, white sweet must not be given here because white colour brings in the Moon and Venus together, and Venus is debilitated in this sign, Virgo.
cells_derived_method: White items are safe where Venus is not debilitated, so the same donation reads differently by sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus is exalted in Pisces, so a white sweet donation on the 9th would be well supported; not said by him.
Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus on the 9th likewise allows white sweets; not said by him.

classical_check: Agrees that Venus is debilitated in Virgo; the white-sweet ban is his own.

hindi: अगर ऐसा व्यक्ति गुरुद्वारे मंदिर में जाकर घी का दान करता है तो गए उसके घुटने उसको इतना पिटेगा
says: If such a person donates ghee at a gurudwara or temple, he will be severely hit, and he even says the knees would go; ghee is treated as a Venus-type item with debilitated Venus here, and this is a health-related warning, not medical advice.
cells_derived_method: Venus-linked items such as ghee would be safe when Venus is strong, for example in Taurus or Pisces.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign on the 9th would allow ghee donation; not said by him.
Derived: Venus exalted on the 9th makes ghee donation fine; not said by him.

ambiguity: He does not name the planet for ghee; Venus is inferred from the preceding Venus-debilitated line. Knee harm is a prediction by him.
classical_check: Differs: ghee is classically a Jupiter-type or general auspicious offering.

gist: Dramatised lament of the victim: went to the gurudwara, lit only a ghee lamp, and came back with tears of blood; ends with 'never do it even by mistake'.
Housekeeping: asks what is left in between, Mercury, since Mars is done.

hindi: बुध बहुत अच्छा है आप हरी दाल दे सकते हो मूंग की दाल
says: Mercury's donation looks very good at first: green lentil, the moong dal, is Mercury's item that can be given.
ambiguity: He immediately qualifies it in the next sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: green moong is a classical Mercury dana.

hindi: लेकिन मूंग की यहां देने का नुकसान क्या है यहां 12 नंबर में नीच राशि होगी तो बुध का दान यहां करने से इधर
says: But giving moong here has a drawback: Mercury's debilitation sign, number 12 (Pisces), sits in this chart, so a Mercury donation here goes against the person.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's donation is unsafe where its debilitation sign falls on a house that the donation would touch; where Pisces is placed differently the verdict changes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Pisces on the 9th would mean Mercury's fall sits on the dharma house, making a Mercury donation there risky; not said by him.
Derived: Pisces on the 3rd, as in this example chart, puts the fall on the house of effort and siblings; not said by him.

ambiguity: 'यहां 12 नंबर' could mean sign 12 or house 12; taken as sign 12 since he says it is the debilitation sign. Sentence ends in the next chunk.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is debilitated in Pisces; the donation rule is his own.

hindi: नुकसान है अगर यह घर प्रोटेक्टेड है यहां कोई और प्लेनेट बैठा है बृहस्पति बैठा है मंगल बैठा है केतु बैठा है राहु राहु ही क्यों नहीं बैठा यहां सारा प्रोटेक्टेड रहेगा दे सकते हो कोई दिक्कत नहीं आएगी
says: The harm applies only if the house is unprotected; if some other planet sits there, whether Jupiter, Mars, Ketu or even Rahu, the house is protected and you can donate without problem.
cells_derived_method: Protection depends on whether a planet occupies the house, so a donation that is risky on an empty house is safe on an occupied one.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter sitting in own sign on the 9th protects the house, so donations there are safe; not said by him.
Derived: Mars in own sign on the 3rd protects that house; donations tied to it would be safe; not said by him.
Derived: an empty 12th house would be unprotected, so donations tied to it would be risky; not said by him.

ambiguity: 'Protected' means occupied by any planet; only four planets are named and the rest are not excluded. Sentence begins in the previous chunk.
classical_check: Silent; this occupant-protects rule is his own, close in spirit to the Lal Kitab idea of a sleeping versus awake house.

gist: Closing phrase: this is how it goes.

hindi: बृहस्पति के लिए य दान करना नॉट गुड बृहस्पति आपकी बुद्धि है ज्ञान है राहु उसको ग्रसित कर जाता है इसलिए आपके सारे ज्ञान की बैंड बज जाएगी
says: A Jupiter donation is not good here: Jupiter stands for your intellect and knowledge and Rahu swallows it, so all your knowledge gets upset.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter donation is unsafe when Rahu shares or rules the sign; with no Rahu link and Jupiter strong it would be fine.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign on the 9th with no Rahu link allows Jupiter donation; not said by him.
Derived: Jupiter debilitated in Capricorn on the 9th would also make the donation risky, though not for Rahu's reason; not said by him.

ambiguity: Link between Rahu's rulership of Virgo and Jupiter donation is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees that Rahu afflicts Jupiter (Guru Chandala); donation rule is his own.

hindi: जाके आप धार्मिक किताबें दे आए जी आपने राम नाम लिखा और जाकर के मंदिर में देके आ रहे हो आपने रामायण के खूब सारे किताबें खरीद ली और मंदिर में देकर के आ रहे हो
says: Giving religious books, notebooks of written Ram-naam, or bought copies of the Ramayana to the temple counts as a Jupiter donation of knowledge, which he warns against here.
ambiguity: The warning's cell is carried over from the previous sentence.
classical_check: Agrees that books and scriptures are Jupiter items.

hindi: बृहस्पति है ज्ञान धर्म से संबंधित और यहां राशि यह है उसके बाद से आपके बुरे दिन शुरू
says: Jupiter is knowledge and dharma, and with this sign, Virgo on the 9th, your bad days begin after such a donation.
ambiguity: 'यह राशि' is read as the Virgo example; the delay of the bad days is not quantified.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसे लोग हैं जो विटनेस करेंगे कि यार जब भी हम तीर्थ पर जाते हैं वापस आके बीमार पड़ जाते हैं बुरे दिन शुरू हो जाते हैं
says: As supporting evidence, he says some people will testify that every time they go on pilgrimage they fall ill or get bad days after returning; this is an anecdote, not a health rule.
ambiguity: Which charts are meant is not stated; he implies those with the unprotected 9th sign as in the example.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says this study is necessary and should be in school curricula and syllabus.
Remarks that Sanskrit is taught up to class eight and an extra subject should exist for children from class five; the sentence continues in the next chunk.
Wants kids to at least know the basics so they do not spread superstition; jokes that children are parasites who drink their parents' blood, all normal and cute.

hindi: ये शनि के लिए यहां दान कर सकते हैं आप शनि महाराज का जो है काला सामान होता है सारा का सारा और जितना मटेरियल धरती से निकला वो दे सकते हैं
says: For Saturn you can donate here: all black articles and every material that comes out of the earth are Saturn's items.
classical_check: Agrees: black cloth, iron, oil and minerals are classical Saturn dana.

hindi: लेकिन इसका कोई सिर पैर नहीं है फायदा नहीं है क्योंकि शनि की य तीसरी दृष्टि आठ नंबर पर आ जाएगी तो ये यहां प्रॉब्लम करेगा अगर ये घर प्रोटेक्टेड नहीं है तो दिक्कत है
says: Yet the Saturn donation has no use, because Saturn's third aspect falls on number eight and would create trouble if that house is not protected.
cells_derived_method: The target of Saturn's third aspect depends on the placement; counting three from Virgo reaches Scorpio, from Libra reaches Sagittarius, from Aquarius reaches Aries.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn's third aspect landing on an unoccupied Scorpio as the 8th house would be the trouble spot; not said by him.
Derived: Saturn in Aquarius aspects Aries by third aspect, here the 11th house, which should be occupied to stay protected; not said by him.

ambiguity: 'आठ नंबर' could be sign 8 or house 8; Saturn in Virgo's third aspect lands on sign 8, which fits, so cell is Scorpio.
classical_check: Agrees that Saturn's special aspects are the 3rd, 7th and 10th; the protection logic is his own.

hindi: उसके बाद राहु का सामान हो ही गया केतु महाराज दे दो कोई फर्क नहीं है का सामान अपना स्वयं का वो थर्ड हाउस में दिक्कत नहीं देगा
says: Rahu's items are already covered, and Ketu's items can also be given with no harm, since Ketu in the third house will not create a problem.
cells_derived_method: A Ketu donation tied to the 3rd house is safe when Ketu's sign there is not hostile; in other houses the signs change the verdict.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in Pisces on the 3rd gives no trouble per his word; not said as a general rule.
Derived: Ketu in Gemini on the 3rd would be in the sign opposite Rahu's exaltation, a possibly weak spot; not said by him.

ambiguity: Part of the caption is dropped ('का सामान अपना'). The third house is from the example chart.
classical_check: Agrees that Ketu in the 3rd is generally considered comfortable.

hindi: नहीं नहीं राहु केतु तो भाई बहन है भाई बहन नहीं मतलब एक ही है सॉरी
says: He first calls Rahu and Ketu brother and sister, then corrects himself that they are really one and the same body, only two halves.
ambiguity: A slip and self-correction mid-sentence.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu and Ketu are the two halves of the same demon.

hindi: नहीं थर्ड में जैसे 12 नंबर राश है तो वहां प नीच का नहीं हो जाएगा ना ना राहु नीच का नहीं 12 में
says: Asked whether a planet in the third house with the twelfth sign would be debilitated there, he answers no; Rahu is not debilitated in sign twelve.
ambiguity: The question is partly garbled; it is read as asking about Ketu or Rahu in Pisces.
classical_check: Agrees: Pisces is not a debilitation sign for Rahu or Ketu in any standard scheme.

hindi: राहु नौ नंबर में नीच का है राहु तीन नंबर में उच्च है
says: Rahu is debilitated in sign number nine (Sagittarius) and exalted in sign number three (Gemini).
cells_derived_method: Rahu's strength rises in Gemini and falls in Sagittarius, so its donations and effects follow these signs whatever house they occupy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu exalted in Gemini on the 3rd gives bold, communicative results; not said by him.
Derived: Rahu debilitated in Sagittarius on the 9th weakens faith and fortune; not said by him.

ambiguity: Numbers read as sign numbers per series convention, though he sometimes says house numbers.
classical_check: Agrees with the Gemini exaltation and Sagittarius debilitation scheme given by some texts; others use Taurus and Scorpio.

hindi: राहु बुध के घर जाता है तो बुध कहता है अरे आइए आइए बुध वाणी है राहु ज्ञान है
says: When Rahu enters Mercury's house, Mercury welcomes it warmly; Mercury is speech and Rahu is knowledge, so the two combine well.
cells_derived_method: The house where Mercury's sign falls decides which field the speech-knowledge pair serves, such as the 3rd for media, the 5th for teaching or the 10th for career.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu in Gemini on the 3rd suits writing, broadcasting and sales; not said by him.
Derived: Rahu in Virgo on the 10th suits analytical or technical work; not said by him.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini on the 5th suits teaching, coaching and clever creativity; not said by him.

ambiguity: 'Mercury's house' is both Gemini and Virgo; in his scheme Virgo is shared with Rahu.
classical_check: Agrees: Rahu is friendly to Mercury and does well in Mercury's signs.

hindi: ये जो हम बकबक कर रहे हैं ये राहु है केतु जिस यानी हम बकबक कर रहे हैं अच्छा ठीक है
says: He says that his own talking in this lecture is itself Rahu at work, joking that the chatter comes from Rahu.
ambiguity: Part of the caption is garbled ('केतु जिस'), which may be a stray word.
classical_check: Silent; self-referential remark.

hindi: अब राहु है यहां पर बुध हो गया यहीं पर आपका तीन और छ नंबर राशि है ये चार पांच है या तीन और छ है तीन और छ
says: Rahu and Mercury are both here in this example, and the signs belonging to Mercury are numbers three and six, Gemini and Virgo; he double-checks that it is three and six, not four and five.
classical_check: Agrees: Gemini and Virgo are Mercury's signs.

hindi: यहां पर छ नंबर में राहु बैठा है य बुध बैठा है अब बुध जो है वाणी यह ज्ञान के पास गई ज्ञान वाणी के पास गया
says: With Rahu and Mercury both sitting in sixth sign Virgo, speech goes to knowledge and knowledge to speech, which is why the pair is strong in expression.
cells_derived_method: Rahu-Mercury in Virgo shows differently by house: speaking skills in the 2nd, work and service in the 6th, public image in the 10th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Rahu and Mercury in Virgo on the 2nd would give sharp, persuasive speech; not said by him.
Derived: in Virgo on the 6th, the pair would give analytical skill in competition and service; not said by him.

classical_check: Agrees that Mercury and Rahu together sharpen intellect, though classics add cunning.

hindi: बुध सूर्य के तत्काल साथ रहता है बुद्ध आदित्य योग बनाता है
says: Mercury stays always very close to the Sun and so forms the Budhaditya yoga.
classical_check: Agrees: Budhaditya yoga is the Sun-Mercury conjunction, and Mercury never goes beyond about 28 degrees from the Sun.

hindi: बुद्ध महाराज बैठ कर के बुद्ध वाणिज्य धन व्यापार बनिए कैसे कमाते बनिए बैठे हुए हैं गद्दी पर और कमा रहे हैं कोई भी व्यक्ति जो इस तरह कमा रहा है वो बनिया है उसका बुद्ध एक्टिवेट हो गया है
says: Mercury rules commerce, money and trade: a shopkeeper earns just by sitting on his seat, and anyone earning that way has his Mercury activated.
cells_derived_method: Mercury's trade results appear most in the 2nd, 7th, 10th and 11th houses, and strongest in Gemini or Virgo.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Gemini on the 7th suggests earning through partnerships and trade; not said by him.
Derived: Mercury in Virgo on the 11th gives steady gains through commerce and accounts; not said by him.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is the karaka of trade and commerce.

hindi: वो वैश्य है सामान पैसे चीज सप्लाई करता है वो वो बुध का कार्य कर रहा है बनि का कार्य कर रहा है
says: Such a person is a Vaishya who supplies goods and money, so his activity is Mercury's work, the trader's work.
classical_check: Agrees: the Vaishya varna and trading are attached to Mercury in classical texts.

hindi: अब वो बैठ के राहु के घर गया ज्ञान हो गया ना बुद्धिमान बुद्धि से ही कमा लेते हैं हेलो इतनी पेटी उतनी पेटी पेटी पेटी खेलते खेल के पेटिया छाप लेते हैं
says: When Mercury goes into Rahu's house, he says the person earns purely by intellect, making big deals and large sums by wit, the trader turned speculator; this is a description, not investment advice.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Rahu's sign Virgo shows big deals in the 2nd, 7th, 10th and 11th houses and less in the 6th, 8th and 12th.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in Virgo on the 11th gives large gains by clever dealing; not said by him.
Derived: Mercury in Virgo on the 8th would give sudden, risky gains and losses; not said by him.

ambiguity: The slang 'peti' means large sums of money; no figures are given. Rahu's house is Virgo in his scheme.
classical_check: Silent on speculation; Mercury in own or exalted Virgo is a classically good trade placement.

gist: Garbled joke that only a Brahmin can ferry such traders across, then claims to be a very strong Brahmin himself.

hindi: तो ऐसे राहु जब बुद्ध के घर जाता है तो वो यही ज्योतिष च य जो चल रहा है राहु बकबक नहीं राहु मेरा भाई है यह राहु ही बोल रहा है
says: So when Rahu goes into Mercury's house you get exactly what is happening now, an astrology lecture, as it is Rahu in Mercury's house that speaks.
ambiguity: The caption is garbled near the middle ('राहु बकबक नहीं'), so the exact wording is uncertain.
classical_check: Silent; Rahu with Mercury for astrologers is a common modern view.

hindi: यह ज्ञान अगर निकलने लायक है तो बुद्ध की कृपा है नहीं तो ज्ञान है निकलता नहीं है पता नहीं कैसे निकल रहा है यह फ्री फंड में निकल रहा है
says: If the knowledge is able to come out, it is by Mercury's grace; otherwise it does not come, and he says it flows out free of effort, he does not know how.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: तो यह राहु और बुध का सम्मेलन हैय एक दूसरे के घर में उच के होते हैं
says: This is a meeting of Rahu and Mercury, and each is in an exalted-like state when in the other's house.
cells_derived_method: Mercury exalted in Virgo and Rahu exalted in Gemini give strength in different houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury exalted in Virgo on the 10th gives a strong career; not said by him.
Derived: Rahu in Gemini on the 1st gives a sharp, unconventional personality; not said by him.

classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is exalted in Virgo, and Rahu is exalted in Gemini in the scheme he stated earlier.

hindi: आओ भाई सबसे ऊंचा आसन लो मेरा भी आसन ले लो यह सबसे ऊंचा आसन देते हैं एक दूसरे को क्योंकि यह स्पेस एलिमेंट है यह आकाश तत्व है
says: Rahu and Mercury offer each other the highest seat because both belong to the space element, the akasha tattva.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give Mercury the earth element and Jupiter the ether element.

hindi: इसीलिए ऐसे लोग बदतमीज होते हैं क्या कहता रहता हूं अपने बारे में क्योंकि यहां का कार्य करने वाले सारे कड़वे होते हैं
says: This is why people of this Rahu-Mercury type tend to be rude and bitter, he says, jokingly about himself, since all who do this kind of work turn out harsh.
ambiguity: Self-mocking tone.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: इसलिए जो ड डक्ट ज्ञान दे रहे हैं हम जो बकबक कर रहे हैं ऐसे ही कोई बड़े ज्ञानी वो सब बदतमीज होते हैं वो परवाह नहीं करते क्या गंदा बोला अच्छा क्योंकि वो आकाश तत्व है
says: Great knowledgeable people who lecture like this are rude and do not care if they speak badly, because they are of the akasha element.
ambiguity: Whether all big scholars, not just Rahu types, is not clear.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: आकाश तत्व क्या है घर के अंदर वेस्ट जोन वेस्ट जोन क्या है कुल्हाड़ी लोहा मेटल काट देता है सबको तो इस कारण बदतमीजी आई जाती है
says: Akasha in the home is the west zone, and the west zone is the axe, iron and metal that cuts everything, which is the reason rudeness comes in.
ambiguity: He does not name Saturn here; the west zone is Saturn's in vastu, so Saturn is inferred.
classical_check: Agrees that west is Saturn's direction in vastu; the link to rudeness is his own.

gist: Apologises jokingly: not my fault, please forgive me.

hindi: यहां राहु हो गया केतु हो गया हमारा यहीं हम यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो हमने वैसे लिए नहीं है जरूरत नहीं है उसकी इतनी
says: Rahu and Ketu are now dealt with, and he sets aside Uranus, Neptune and Pluto for the moment as not needed for this part of the donation scheme.
ambiguity: Unclear if he means these three are not used in the 9th-house donation example or not used in his scheme at all; later rows show he does use them.
classical_check: Differs from classical practice, which never uses the outer planets.

hindi: यूरेनस इंद्र का सामान है इंद्र का सामान क्या है भोग
says: Uranus is Indra, and Indra's items stand for enjoyment, pleasure and indulgence.
ambiguity: Equating Uranus with Indra is part of his twelve-planet scheme.
classical_check: Differs: not in classical texts, where Indra is a deity and Uranus is unknown.

hindi: राहु क्या है पितरों को रिप्रेजेंट करने वाला संत साधु
says: Rahu stands for the ancestors and also the saint or sadhu, the two being the same line of authority.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk with the donation rule for this planet.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts associate pitras with Sun and Ketu and the 9th house rather than Rahu.

hindi: बृहस्पति हो गया शुक्र शुक्र घी सफेद मिश्री खीर दही यह सब दे सकते हैं आप शुक्र सामान
says: Jupiter is done, and in Venus's turn you can give ghee, white sugar candy, kheer and curd, all Venus items, with Libra on the 9th.
cells_derived_method: Venus donations are safe where Venus is in own or exalted sign and unsafe where debilitated.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in own sign Taurus on the 9th permits Venus items; not said by him.
Derived: Venus debilitated in Virgo on the 9th made Venus items risky, as he said earlier.

classical_check: Agrees that ghee, sugar candy, kheer and curd are Venus dana.

hindi: एक्स्ट्रा सफेद कपड़ा दे सकते हैं आप श्रृंगार का सामान वस्त्र सौंदर्य की चीजें यह सारी की सारी आप बड़े आराम से दो सात नंबर
says: Also white cloth, cosmetics, clothes and beauty items can all be given comfortably when the seventh sign is on the 9th.
ambiguity: Contrasts with the Virgo case where these were barred.
classical_check: Agrees that white cloth and cosmetics are Venus dana.

hindi: आनंद आ गया कितना ही सुंदर तरीका हो जाए कि आपका शुक्र यहां प्लेस होता है आपके जीवन में आनंद होएगा भोजन दे दो आप खाना लंगर करा दो
says: With Venus placed here your life will have joy; give food or arrange a langar at the temple.
ambiguity: Whether Venus must actually occupy the house is not clear; he says 'placed here'.
classical_check: Agrees that Venus in own sign Libra gives pleasure and comfort.

hindi: भोजन स्वादिष्ट भोजन हो गया मजा आ रहा है बहुत अच्छा लग रहा है यह सारा का सारा कार्यक्रम शुक्र की प्लेसमेंट से होता है
says: Tasty food, pleasure and a good feeling all come from Venus's placement, so enjoyment of food is a Venus matter.
classical_check: Agrees: Venus is karaka of pleasures and food enjoyment.

hindi: शनि महाराज यहां पर है लोहे की ग्रिल लगवा दो लोहे की ग्रिल लगवा दो काला पेंट दे दो लाजवाब काम करेगा
says: For Saturn here, get an iron grill fitted at the shrine and give black paint, and it will work wonderfully.
cells_derived_method: Saturn donations work best where Saturn is exalted or in own sign, as in Libra, Capricorn or Aquarius.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign Capricorn on the 9th also supports iron and black items; not said by him.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in Aries on the 9th would make iron donations less reliable; not said by him.

classical_check: Agrees that iron and black items are Saturn dana, and Saturn is exalted in Libra.

hindi: आप सीमेंट देते हैं वह सूर्य बन जाता है बदरपुर देते हैं मंगल बन जाता है लाल ईट देते हैं मंगल बन जाता है
says: Among building materials, cement counts as the Sun, gravel as Mars, and red bricks as Mars, so what you give for construction maps to different planets.
classical_check: Silent on construction materials; red brick as Mars is common.

hindi: और भी कुछ होता है क्या होता है पता नहीं और क्या होता है और भी लगता है लेबर का काम करना पड़ेगा तभी समझ आएगा ये शनि हो गया
says: Other materials may also apply but he is unsure, and one must do labour work to understand it; physical labour belongs to Saturn.
ambiguity: Rambling caption; the main point is labour as Saturn.
classical_check: Agrees that manual labour is Saturn's.

hindi: आप यहां पर दे सकते हैं आपको धन मन नहीं देना लोहे के ग्रले लगवा दो काला पेंट करा देना
says: For Saturn here you need not give money or mind, just have iron grills fitted and black paint applied; the labour or material is the gift.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: उसके ऊपर राहु महाराज यहां देते हैं कोई सिर पैर नहीं राहु का क्या करोगे देखके
says: Rahu items given here make no sense in this setup, so he asks what you would do with Rahu's donation after looking at the chart.
ambiguity: The caption is rough; read as Rahu donation being pointless here, similar to his Jupiter remark.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: केतु का देना है केतु का देना य बहुत बर्बादी कर देगा
says: Giving Ketu's items here will cause a great deal of ruin, so he warns strongly against a Ketu donation in this setup.
ambiguity: The reading 'will ruin you' is taken from the word बर्बादी; earlier in the 9th Virgo example he allowed Ketu items, so the two differ by sign.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: केतु का सामान क्या होगा झाड़ू दे दी सफाई के सारे सामान जो आपके घर के जो सामान खराबी करते हैं डंडा पकड़ते हैं हम उसका झाड़ू का ऊपर से नीचे झाड़ू का निचला
says: Ketu's items are the broom and all cleaning equipment, the things that clear out dirt, and he begins to explain how the broom's lower part is the Ketu portion, though the sentence breaks off.
ambiguity: Caption is cut at the end and is garbled in the middle; head-versus-tail logic may link the broom's handle to Rahu and the bristles to Ketu.
classical_check: Silent; brooms are a Ketu or Saturn article in some folk traditions.

hindi: केतु क्या है सफाई कमाल सारे जीवन भर में स्वर्ग मोक्ष का द्वार केतु ही मोक्ष का द्वार है
says: Ketu stands for cleanliness and purification, and he calls it the doorway to heaven and moksha (liberation) in a person's life.
ambiguity: Caption begins mid-sentence ('हिस्सा टच होता है'), so the preceding context is missing.
classical_check: Agrees: Ketu is the classical moksha karaka.

gist: Aside about women asking whether they look beautiful and a joke that a man is not complete until he has a few bruises or scars; 'please do not start hitting each other'.

hindi: केतु ही सुख देता है और केतु ही जीवन के अंदर क्लेरिटी देता है हर चीज की विजन अच्छी देता है
says: Ketu is the giver of happiness, mental clarity and a good vision (foresight) about everything in life.
ambiguity: 'विजन' may mean eyesight or vision in the sense of foresight; the context (clarity) suggests foresight.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts treat Ketu as detachment and confusion as often as clarity; clarity after detachment is a later view.

hindi: जीवन में भोग के पश्चात तृप्ति का भी केतु ही द्वार है
says: After a person has enjoyed worldly pleasures, the feeling of satisfaction and having had enough comes through Ketu.
classical_check: Silent on satiety specifically; consistent with Ketu as vairagya (dispassion) karaka.

hindi: केतु ही आपके द्वारा किए गए धन को अनजान लोगों तक पहुंचा के समाज को वापस दिलवा है
says: Ketu is the channel through which wealth you give away reaches unknown people and returns to society; donation to strangers works through Ketu.
ambiguity: Caption 'वापस दिलवा है' is garbled; meaning inferred as 'gives back to society'.
classical_check: Silent; classical Ketu remedies do include charity to the unknown or lowly, so broadly consistent.

hindi: सब चीज केतु ही संतान जन्म के लिए उत्तरदायित्व है
says: Ketu is responsible for the birth of children (progeny), in his scheme.
ambiguity: Could mean birth of children only, or everything that is 'born' from you; the next sentence widens it to created objects.
classical_check: Differs: classical karaka for children is Jupiter; Ketu is linked to the 5th through spiritual, past-life or loss-of-child readings. He is adding a Ketu role, not replacing Jupiter.

hindi: आपने कोई घर में सोफा लिया आपने घर में अलमारी बनाई वो संतान ही है आपकी क्योंकि आप ही बना रहे हैं उसको तो आप मेनिफेस्ट कर पा रहे हैं
says: Anything you create, such as a sofa or cupboard for the house, counts as your 'child', because you manifest it. Ketu has a large role in this manifestation.
ambiguity: A personal extension (creation = progeny), not a rule he ties to a house or sign.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own interpretation.

hindi: जो स्त्रियां अपने जीवन के अंदर सौंदर्य चाहती हैं ... तो केतु हमारी सारी स्किन तो स्किन सुंदर हो जाए शरीर के अंग सुंदर हो जाए
says: Women who want beauty should work on Ketu: Ketu governs skin and the shape of body parts, and a well-treated Ketu brings sweetness in life and in the mindset.
ambiguity: Classically skin is Venus/Mercury/Saturn; here Ketu is given a skin and beauty role.
classical_check: Differs: Venus is the classical beauty karaka; skin is usually Mercury or Saturn.

hindi: ये राहु है केतु निचला हिस्सा है और आपकी काया बहुत अच्छे से आपका काम करके दे सके
says: Rahu is the upper part of the body (head side) and Ketu the lower part, and a healthy Ketu lets the body (kaya) perform its work well.
ambiguity: Caption is choppy; the Rahu-head / Ketu-lower-body split matches the usual head and tail imagery.
classical_check: Agrees with the common head (Rahu) and tail (Ketu) imagery, though the classical texts do not assign body parts so cleanly.

hindi: केतु पीठ है अगर आपकी पीठ में दर्द है तो केतु की डिस्टरबेंस है वो रीड की हड्डी को पकड़ता है सारा का सारा यानी पूरी बॉडी को मेंटेन करने का काम
says: Ketu is the back and the spine, which holds up the whole body. He says back pain indicates Ketu disturbance. This is a body-part correspondence recorded as his claim, not a medical diagnosis.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts give the back and spine to Sun (bones), Saturn or the 6th and 8th houses; Ketu with the spine is a modern view.

hindi: केतु के लिए आप क्या कर सकते हैं सारा का सारा भोग का सामान धर्म से संबंधित सामान ज्ञान का सामान सफाई का सामान यह सब वहां पर आप दे सकते हैं
says: Remedy for Ketu: donate items of enjoyment, religious items, items of knowledge and cleaning items.
ambiguity: 'वहां' (there) probably means to unknown recipients, as he explains next.
classical_check: Differs: classical Ketu donations are a blanket, sesame, a dog's food, a multi-coloured cloth or iron; this list is his own.

hindi: केतु अपने आप में वो प्लेनेट है जिसकी दृष्टि सबसे ज्यादा है वरुण के बाद वरुण की दृष्टि सारे जगह पे होती है
says: In his scheme Varuna (Neptune) aspects every place, and Ketu has the widest aspect of all planets after Neptune.
ambiguity: 'सबसे ज्यादा' may refer to the count of houses aspected or to strength.
classical_check: Differs: classical Parashari gives Rahu and Ketu no standard aspects (some schools give them 5, 7, 9); outer planets are not in the classical system.

hindi: केतु की बृहस्पति वाली भी है शनि वाली भी है मंगल वाली भी है
says: Ketu casts the special aspects of Jupiter, Saturn and Mars, which is why he sees so many houses: 5th and 9th like Jupiter, 3rd and 10th like Saturn, 4th and 8th like Mars.
cells_derived_method: Ketu in a house also sees the houses counted from itself: 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 9 and 10, so the reach changes with Ketu's house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Ketu in the 1st would aspect the 3rd, 4th, 5th, 7th, 8th, 9th and 10th, touching most of the chart from the lagna.
Derived: Ketu in the 6th would aspect the 8th, 9th, 10th, 12th, 1st, 2nd and 3rd, linking enemies and debts to wealth and the self.
Derived: Ketu in the 10th would aspect the 12th, 1st, 2nd, 4th, 5th, 6th and 7th, so career detachment spreads to home, mind and marriage.

ambiguity: He lists the three special-aspect planets only; the exact house counts are the standard special aspects, not stated by him.
classical_check: Differs: this is not classical Parashari; it is closer to a Jaimini or Nadi-influenced view.

hindi: स्त्रियों के लिए बहुत आवश्यक है कि वो अपने द्वारा भोगी गई कोई चीज जो उन्होंने वस्त्र इत्यादि अपने शरीर पर पहने हैं वो हर हालत में दान करें
says: Remedy for women: whatever they have used or worn on the body, such as clothes, must in every case be donated, as a Ketu remedy.
ambiguity: Sentence runs into the next caption block; the recipient condition follows there.
classical_check: Silent; classical Ketu charity concerns old or used items to the poor, which loosely agrees.

hindi: कहां दान दें अनजान लोगों को दें ये थोड़ा सा यहां का आ जाएगा साथ में
says: The used items must go to unknown strangers; he notes this will tie in with the topic he is covering here.
ambiguity: 'यहां का आ जाएगा' is vague; it seems to preview the donation list that follows.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कभी ये ना सोचे कि भाई मैंने काम वाली को अपनी साड़ी दी है तो उसने प्रेम नहीं दिया वो अनजान को देना है क्योंकि वो केतु है
says: Do not expect love in return from a maid you gave your saree to. That gift is not the Ketu remedy: the recipient must be an unknown person, because this is Ketu.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: केतु आपके शरीर के स्पर्श किया गया सारा सामान है अपने द्वारा यूज की गई चीजें सौंदर्य प्रसाधन लिपस्टिक क्रीम इत्यादि
says: Ketu rules everything your body has touched: used items and cosmetics such as lipstick and cream.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own significator list.

hindi: आप देते हैं कामवाली को दे दो खुश करने के लिए वो खुश नहीं होगी वो दोष है
says: Giving used cosmetics or items to the maid to please her will not please her and is itself a dosha (fault) for the giver.
ambiguity: Whether 'dosha' means a karmic fault or just a social slip is not clear.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He says the talk drifted a little off-track and that the Ketu section is now finished.

hindi: राहु लंबे बाल है केतु जुड़ा है इसीलिए सिर ढक के जाया जाता है
says: Rahu is the long hair and Ketu is the knot (bun) of hair; for this reason the head is covered when entering a holy place.
classical_check: Silent; classical Rahu and Ketu hair significations are not standard.

hindi: गुरुद्वारे में मंदिर में चुन्नी लेते हैं वहां पर इसलिए कहते हैं इसको राहु और केतु को ढक दो भाई यह दोनों के दोनों बृहस्पति के स्थान में नहीं आने चाहिए
says: The head is covered with a dupatta in gurudwaras and temples to cover Rahu and Ketu, because neither should come into Jupiter's place (the place of worship and knowledge).
classical_check: Silent; a reasoning for the custom, not a classical rule.

hindi: इनको हाथ जोड़ के रखो इसीलिए आप मुसलमानों के यहां चले जाओ वहां पर भी आपका सिर ढका होता है सिख लोगों में चले जाओ चुन्नी डाल लेती है लेडीज और सिर प पगड़ी होती है
says: Keep Rahu and Ketu with folded hands (subdued). He cites that head covering is found in Muslim practice, among Sikhs with turbans and dupattas, as support.
classical_check: Silent; a cultural observation used as supporting evidence.

hindi: हिंदू धर्म ग्रंथियों में जा साफा बांधते हैं उसकी पगड़ी को साफा बोलते हैं
says: Hindu traditions also tie a cloth (safa, a form of pagri) on the head, adding to his list of head-covering customs that he links to Rahu and Ketu.
ambiguity: 'धर्म ग्रंथियों' is garbled, probably 'Hindu religious communities'.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: स्त्रियों के लिए भी चुन्नी बोली गई है तोय राहु केतु महाराज चुप रहे शांत बैठे
says: For women too the dupatta is prescribed, so that Rahu and Ketu sit quiet and calm.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सात नंबर हो गया आठ नंबर इंद्र देवता के कार्यक्रम है यह हमारे आठ नंबर यह इंद्र का कार्यक्रम हो गया
says: He moves to number 8 in his list, which belongs to Indra (Uranus), after finishing number 7 (Rahu and Ketu). His donation discussion for Indra follows.
ambiguity: 'आठ नंबर' could be the 8th item in his planet list or the 8th sign Scorpio (which he later calls the 8th sign, with Uranus as one of its two lords in his scheme). Cell is recorded as Scorpio on that reading.
classical_check: Silent; Uranus is outside classical Jyotish, though Scorpio as sign 8 is standard.

hindi: यहां पर सूर्य यहां लाजवाब है
says: The Sun does excellently here, in the number 8 (Scorpio, Mars and Indra's place).
cells_derived_method: The Sun in Scorpio is in a friend's sign (Mars). The house it occupies decides what it energizes.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 10th in Scorpio gives a forceful, investigative style of authority and career.
Derived: Sun in the 5th in Scorpio makes intelligence and dealings with children intense and secretive.
Derived: Sun in the 12th in Scorpio points to hidden expenses, foreign links and a deep inner life.

ambiguity: Unclear whether 'यहां' is the sign Scorpio or the donation slot of number 8.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Sun in Scorpio (Mars's friendly sign) is comfortable but not exalted; 'laajawab' overstates the classical position.

hindi: चंद्रमा यहां बर्बाद है नीच का होता है सबसे खराब तबाह कर देगा
says: The Moon is ruined here: debilitated in Scorpio, the worst placement, which will wreck the matters of the Moon.
cells_derived_method: Moon is debilitated in Scorpio. What gets hurt depends on the house: mind and mother matters spread over that house's topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon in the 4th strains peace at home and mother's wellbeing.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 7th makes emotional dealings in partnership volatile.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 10th gives an unsteady public image and a career linked to the masses.

classical_check: Agrees: Moon is debilitated in Scorpio.

hindi: सूर्य गेहूं साजो सामान किसी किस्म की चीज जो प्रकाश देती है
says: Sun's items for donation: wheat and anything that gives light.
classical_check: Agrees: wheat is a classical Sun donation.

hindi: जैसे आप मंगल का सामान देते हैं आप मंगल अपने घर का बहुत शानदार आएगा लाइट अग्नि बिजली की तारें लाल रंग की बिजली की तार चल जाएगी पीले रंग की चल जाएगी
says: Mars items (light, fire, electric wires) are very good to give here: red-coloured wire works, and yellow wire works too, since Mars is in its own home in number 8 (Scorpio).
cells_derived_method: Mars is in its own sign Scorpio, so Mars gifts are accepted whatever the house; what is being protected shifts with the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in own sign in the 2nd supports a firm, blunt way of speaking and earning through effort.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 6th is strong against enemies and illness-causing habits.
Derived: Mars in own sign in the 9th gives a forceful, argumentative belief system.

ambiguity: Mix of donation advice and placement; the donation setting is a religious place per the later sentences.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Mars is in own sign in Scorpio; classical Mars donations are red items, masoor dal and copper, not electrical wire.

hindi: काली नहीं चलेगी क्योंकि आठ नंबर राशि में शनि खत्म होता है बर्बाद होता है तबाह कर देता है
says: Black-coloured wire will not do, because Saturn is ruined and finished in the 8th sign (Scorpio); black (Saturn's colour) harms there.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in Scorpio is not classically debilitated; the harm he claims shows up in whichever house Saturn sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in the 3rd in Scorpio blocks efforts and siblings relations.
Derived: Saturn in the 8th in Scorpio can bring obstacles in longevity topics and sudden events.
Derived: Saturn in the 11th in Scorpio delays gains and slows friendships.

ambiguity: Saturn is debilitated in Aries and exalted in Libra, not ruined in Scorpio. He may mean that Saturn is weak in a Mars sign, or may be speaking of a different count (house 8).
classical_check: Differs: Saturn is neutral/enemy in Scorpio, not debilitated; he overstates.

hindi: चंद्रमा पानी पानी अगर आपने दे दिया है चावल दे दिया है सफेद कपड़ा दे दिया है आपकी जिंदगी नर्क है
says: If Moon items (water, rice, white cloth) are given here, your life becomes hell: the Moon is debilitated in the number 8 sign, so its gifts backfire.
cells_derived_method: Moon debilitated in Scorpio makes Moon gifts harmful, whichever house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Moon on the rising sign side gives an anxious, moody personality.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 4th hits domestic comfort the hardest.
Derived: debilitated Moon in the 9th shakes faith and fortune.

ambiguity: Classically Moon donation is white items; here he forbids it, based on Scorpio debilitation.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts prescribe white items for a weak Moon, not forbid them.

hindi: आप धर्म स्थान में नहीं दे सकते धर्म स्थान की बात हो रही है अनजान की बात नहीं हो रही है
