hindi: मंगल महाराज का क्या है यह कहता है मैं बस तोड़ दूंगा फोड़ दूंगा आग लगा दूंगा अब अग्नि का क्या काम है अग्नि किसी को नहीं छोड़ती अग्नि का स्वरूप है मंगल
says: Mars is the form of fire; its nature is to break, smash and burn, and fire spares no one.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is the fire planet.

hindi: चार नंबर हमारे खास विशेष भाव होते हैं कुंडली में यह 12वां घर है यह तीसरा यह छठा आठवा यह बुरे माने जाते हैं
says: Four houses are special in the chart: the 12th, 3rd, 6th and 8th, which are considered bad houses.
cells_derived_method: A planet in any of these houses carries the troubles of that house, in the sign it occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 6th in Scorpio faces enemies and illness with intensity.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Aquarius brings slow, long drawn changes.
Derived: a planet in the 12th in Leo gives expenses linked to status and ego.

ambiguity: 'चार नंबर' means four houses here, not sign 4. The 3rd is added to the usual dusthanas 6, 8, 12.
classical_check: Partly agrees: 6, 8 and 12 are dusthanas; the 3rd is an upachaya, usually not treated as bad, though some call it a minor dusthana for health.

hindi: कोर्ट कचहरी का यह मृत्यु का है यह पराक्रम का है लेकिन यह मौत की भी मौत है आठवें घर से एक दो तीन चार पांच छह सात
says: The 6th is about court cases, the 8th about death and the 3rd about valor, but the 3rd is also the death of death: counting seven houses on from the 8th gives the 3rd, so it can kill death.
cells_derived_method: The 3rd is the 8th from the 8th house; this bhavat-bhavam logic says the 3rd cancels the 8th's harm.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a planet in the 3rd in Aries brings valor that protects against losses of the 8th house.
Derived: a planet in the 6th in Virgo concerns litigation and service.
Derived: a planet in the 8th in Scorpio relates to death and transformation.

ambiguity: Caption counts 'एक दो तीन ... सात' from the 8th; the 3rd house is 8+7=15 minus 12.
classical_check: Agrees: bhavat bhavam counting makes the 3rd the 8th from the 8th (longevity of longevity).

hindi: यह आपके खर्चे हैं वेस्टेज खर्च पेन बीमारी मौत मौत भी यही है
says: The 12th house stands for expenses, wastage, pain, illness and also death.
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 12th shows what kind of loss: sign nature times house nature.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: 12th house in Taurus implies spending on comforts and food.
Derived: 12th house in Gemini implies travel and communication costs.
Derived: 12th house in Capricorn implies costs of duty and long-term obligations.

ambiguity: 'यह' (this) points at a house on a diagram; read as the 12th from the previous list.
classical_check: Agrees: the 12th is loss, expense, hospital and end of life.

hindi: मंगल जब चार का यहां पर आएगा तो तीसरे घर के अंदर पराक्रम मारता है लेकिन चार नंबर का मंगल यह नेगेटिव जगह पर है इसलिए मारेगा भी नहीं
says: Mars in sign 4 (Cancer, debilitated) normally damages valor in the 3rd, but because it sits in a negative place it will not even do that harm.
cells_derived_method: Mars is debilitated in Cancer. If Cancer falls in a negative house, the debilitation turns helpful, in his logic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mars in the 3rd weakens courage but in his logic fails to harm.
Derived: debilitated Mars in the 6th gives a hesitant fight against enemies, yet helps in his reading.
Derived: debilitated Mars in the 12th reduces energy but protects against waste.

ambiguity: Unclear whether 'तीसरे घर के अंदर पराक्रम मारता है' says Mars in the 3rd or Mars aspecting the 3rd.
classical_check: Partly agrees with the idea that a debilitated planet in a dusthana gives better results (viparita idea).

hindi: इन जगहों पर नीच का ग्रह भी अच्छा ही फल देता है
says: In these negative houses even a debilitated planet gives good results.
cells_derived_method: Any planet in its debilitation sign placed in 3, 6, 8 or 12 is read as helpful.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mars in the 6th in Cancer turns into a good fighter against rivals.
Derived: debilitated Saturn in the 8th in Aries gives a long life and endurance.
Derived: debilitated Venus in the 12th in Virgo gives restraint in expenses and bed pleasures.

ambiguity: Spoken in a rush; the statement is inferred from the lines before and after it.
classical_check: Partly agrees: classical texts say malefics do well in 3, 6, 11 and a debilitated planet in a dusthana is read as a viparita type benefit.

hindi: मंगल अकेला ग्रह जो खुद को भी नष्ट नहीं करेगा और बृहस्पति भी नहीं करेगा खुद को नष्ट
says: Mars is the only planet that will not destroy even itself, and Jupiter likewise does not destroy itself.
ambiguity: The caption around it is badly garbled; the meaning might be that they do not spoil their own house results.
classical_check: Partly echoes 'karako bhava nashaya', where a karaka in its own house can harm it; he claims the opposite for Mars and Jupiter.

gist: Garbled caption ('ने जितने भी बोली सर नहीं बुध का गड़बड़ है ... भा रे में ब हा'); only a mention of Mercury going wrong can be seen.

hindi: मंगल तो नेगेटिव को भी नष्ट करता है ना मंगल का तो काम ही अलग है रोशनी भी देगा और नेगेटिव को भी नष्ट करेगा यही तो खिचड़ी है अलग-अलग ग्रहों की
says: Mars also destroys negative forces; it gives light and removes negativity, which is the mixed khichdi of different planetary behaviours.
classical_check: Silent; consistent with Mars as a remover of obstacles.

gist: Fragment about '6 was here, 6 was there, 12 was' is cut off and continues in the next block.

hindi: 12 शुक्र महाराज है ना तो वहां पर हमने अगर बुध का कुछ दिया तो यहां नेगेटिव हो जाएगा तीसरे भाव में वो नेगेटिव हो जाएगा
says: At sign 12 (Pisces) Venus is the one in charge (exalted); if Mercury's items are given there, it turns negative in the 3rd house.
cells_derived_method: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces, so Mercury items turn bad where Venus rules the slot; the harm lands on the 3rd house topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in the 3rd in Pisces weakens communication and writing.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in the 10th in Pisces confuses commercial dealings.
Derived: Mercury debilitated in the 7th in Pisces makes partnership talk vague.

ambiguity: The caption is unclear about whether 'वहां' is Pisces or a house; the 3rd-house link is unclear.
classical_check: Agrees that Mercury is debilitated in Pisces and Venus exalted.

hindi: बुध जो है सौम्य ग्रह है शुक्र सौम्य ग्रह है एक प्रकार से बृहस्पति सौम्य ग्रह है
says: Mercury, Venus and Jupiter are the gentle (saumya) planets in his classification.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter, Venus, Mercury and the waxing Moon are natural benefics.

hindi: क्रूर ग्रह शनि राहु मंगल जो आग है कतल मचा दे मंगल सूर्य के भी काबू में नहीं रहता
says: The cruel planets are Saturn, Rahu and Mars: fire and slaughter; Mars does not stay under the Sun's control either.
ambiguity: Sun and Ketu are left out of his list.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Saturn, Rahu, Mars, Sun and Ketu are classical malefics.

hindi: अगर क्रूर ग्रह है और नेगेटिव जगह है तो पॉजिटिव हो जाता है नेगेटिव नेगेटिव पॉजिटिव
says: A cruel planet in a negative house turns positive: negative times negative gives positive.
cells_derived_method: Malefic in 3, 6, 8 or 12 is read as good; the sign decides the flavour.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 3rd in Aries gives bold initiative and success through effort.
Derived: Saturn in the 6th in Capricorn defeats enemies by patience.
Derived: Rahu in the 12th in Scorpio supports foreign gain and sound sleep disturbance, with a tilt to benefit.

ambiguity: Caption is partly garbled ('बनता हैटन जाता'); the negative-negative rule is the clear part.
classical_check: Agrees in part: malefics do well in the 3rd, 6th and 11th; the 8th and 12th are less favourable.

hindi: नीच का शनि य भी अच्छा नीच का ग्रह मीन पॉजिटिव बुरा
says: Debilitated Saturn is also good in this logic; a debilitated planet means 'positive bad', i.e. less bad, not harmful.
cells_derived_method: Saturn is debilitated in Aries; effect shows in the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 10th in Aries is weak but pushes hard work in career.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 8th in Aries gives long life with delays.
Derived: Saturn debilitated in the 4th in Aries gives a cold or unsettled home.

ambiguity: Sign cell is derived from the dignity table; he says only 'nīcha ka Shani'.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts treat debilitated Saturn as weak, with cancellation cases.

hindi: बहुत लंबी आयु देता है मरने नहीं देता आठवा शनि मरेगा नहीं
says: Saturn in the 8th gives a very long life and does not let the person die early; he says the native will not die. This is a longevity statement, recorded as his claim, with no date or prediction implied.
cells_derived_method: Saturn in the 8th in any sign adds longevity, with sign colouring.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Saturn in own sign in the 8th gives strong longevity and endurance.
Derived: exalted Saturn in the 8th gives long life with hidden gains.
Derived: debilitated Saturn in the 8th gives longevity with obstacles.

classical_check: Agrees: Saturn is the 8th house karaka and in the 8th is classically said to give long life.

hindi: मंगल है सा घर दृष्टि दे रहा है तो पराक्रम को बढ़ाएगा ही ना वो पराक्रम हल्के में भी मौज करा देगा
says: When Mars aspects the 3rd house it boosts valor, and that valor brings enjoyment even with little effort.
cells_derived_method: Mars aspects the 3rd from houses 12 (4th aspect), 9 (7th aspect) and 8 (8th aspect).

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 12th aspects the 3rd by its 4th aspect, boosting siblings, courage and short travels.
Derived: Mars in the 9th aspects the 3rd by its 7th aspect, boosting enterprise through fortune.
Derived: Mars in the 8th aspects the 3rd by its 8th aspect, boosting hidden strength.

ambiguity: Caption 'ब में मंगल है सा घर' is garbled; read as 'Mars gives its aspect to the 3rd house'.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars's aspects help the 3rd house valor.

hindi: मंगल की यहां एक नंबर पे राशि एक नंबर प दृष्टि होगी रॉकेट बन गया
says: From the number 10 slot Mars's aspect falls on sign 1 (Aries, Mars's own sign), which makes it rocket-like.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Capricorn aspects Aries by its 4th aspect, so the aspect lands on its own sign.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 10th (Aries lagna) aspects the 1st house in Aries, strengthening self and health.
Derived: Mars in the 1st (Capricorn lagna) aspects the 4th house in Aries, giving property drive.
Derived: Mars in the 5th (Virgo lagna) aspects the 8th house in Aries, giving hidden strength.

classical_check: Agrees that the 4th aspect from Capricorn reaches Aries.

hindi: पांच नंबर पे होगी सूर्य की राशि है ये भी रॉकेट कर देगा ये भी और ये भी
says: The aspect also falls on sign 5 (Leo), the Sun's sign, which is also rocket-like; all three aspected places do well.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Capricorn aspects Leo by its 8th aspect; Leo is the Sun's own sign, a friend of Mars.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 10th aspects the 5th house in Leo, supporting intelligence and children.
Derived: Mars in the 7th aspects the 2nd house in Leo, supporting speech and wealth.
Derived: Mars in the 2nd (Sagittarius lagna) aspects the 9th house in Leo, supporting fortune.

classical_check: Agrees that the 8th aspect from Capricorn falls on Leo.

hindi: शनि महाराज के रहते सिर्फ आप मीठा तक दे सकते हो लाल चीज दे सकते हो माता के मंदिर में लाल चुन्नी चढ़ा दो काम ही खत्म हो गया आपका
says: With Saturn in charge of this slot you may give only sweets and red things, such as a red chunni at a Mata temple, and your work is done.
classical_check: Differs: classical remedies for Saturn differ; red cloth to Devi is a Mars-type offering.

hindi: वहां माता आ जाती है वहां दुर्गा आ जाती है कोई फर्क नहीं हमें लाल चुन्नी से मतलब है हमें माता के मंदिर में चढ़ाना है माता को नहीं चढ़ाना
says: Whether it is Mata or Durga makes no difference; what matters is the red chunni offered at the Mata temple, not an offering made to the deity as such.
ambiguity: The distinction between 'at the temple' and 'to Mata' is subtle and not explained.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says he will not go into so much depth as it would give people a headache; 'enjoy the class with a Disprin'.

hindi: लोन रीपेमेंट है लेकिन अगर मंगल की दृष्टि है तो लोन रीपेमेंट होगी नहीं
says: On loans: if Mars aspects the matter of the loan, the repayment will not happen.
cells_derived_method: Loans sit in the 6th house; he does not say from where Mars aspects it, so examples vary only the sign of the 6th house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars aspecting a 6th house in Cancer (debilitated Mars) makes loan repayment sticky.
Derived: Mars aspecting a 6th house in Aries gives a stubborn, quarrelsome stance on debts.
Derived: exalted Mars aspecting a 6th house in Capricorn gives forceful repayment demands.

ambiguity: He does not say which house; the 6th is the loan house in standard Jyotish and is assumed here.
classical_check: Silent on exact claim; the 6th house is the classical house of debt.

hindi: आपकी कभी पे मत करो लोन मंगल का हो तो लोन रिपे मत करो कभी भी जिंदगी में
says: He advises never to repay a loan that falls under Mars. This is financial advice recorded as his statement, not endorsed, and it conflicts with ordinary prudence.
ambiguity: Likely tongue in cheek; unclear whether serious.
classical_check: Silent; no classical text advises non-payment.

hindi: बुध आता है बुध शनि का परम मित्र है कोई भी दिक्कत नहीं है
says: Mercury is Saturn's very close friend, so Mercury items cause no problem in Saturn's slot.
cells_derived_method: Mercury in Capricorn is in a friend's sign, comfortable in any house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury in the 10th in Capricorn suits disciplined business and accounting.
Derived: Mercury in the 2nd in Capricorn gives measured speech and steady saving.
Derived: Mercury in the 6th in Capricorn handles service, debts and detail work well.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury and Saturn are mutual friends.

hindi: बुध भी नपुंसक ग्रह है शनि भी नपुंसक है स्त्री ग्रह है आपके शुक्र और चंद्रमा बुध और शनि नपुंसक है पुरुष ग्रह आपके सूर्य मंगल बृहस्पति
says: Gender of planets: Venus and Moon are female, Mercury and Saturn are neuter, and Sun, Mars and Jupiter are male.
classical_check: Agrees with Parashari planet genders.

hindi: पुरुष ग्रह में मंगल ब्रह्मचारी है इसलिए एक ब्रह्मचारी हो गया दो नपुंसक हो गए दो पुरुष हो गए दो स्त्री हो गए
says: Among the male planets Mars is celibate, so the grouping is one celibate, two neuter, two male and two female planets.
ambiguity: The 'brahmachari' label for Mars is his own addition.
classical_check: Partly differs: classical texts call Mars a male planet; the celibate label is a tradition view.

hindi: बृहस्पति यहां पर आएगा 10 नंबर में बृहस्पति अगर आ गया और आपने मंदिर जाना शुरू कर दिया तो आपके बृहस्पति के एक्टिवेशन होने से बाप से आपका रिश्ता खत्म हो जाएगा
says: Jupiter in number 10 (Capricorn, where it is debilitated): if you begin temple visits, Jupiter gets activated and your relationship with your father will end; the father's house gets harmed.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Jupiter in Capricorn: its worship-activation damages the father and the 9th house topics, in whichever house it sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 9th in Capricorn would strain father and faith with religious practice.
Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 4th in Capricorn would strain home and mother when worship starts.
Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 1st in Capricorn would show wisdom blocked and tension with elders.

ambiguity: A strong anti-worship claim; whether it applies to a natal Jupiter in Capricorn or to the donation slot is unclear.
classical_check: Differs: classical texts prescribe worship and charity for a weak Jupiter, not avoidance.

hindi: यह पिता का खाना होता है आपका बाप कोई नहीं होगा सिर्फ जन्म देने वाला पिता नहीं कोई भी नहीं
says: The father's compartment is affected: you would have no father figure at all, not only the birth father but any father-like support.
ambiguity: 'खाना' (compartment) means the house or place in the chart for the father; unclear whether he means 9th house.
classical_check: Partly agrees that the 9th and Sun relate to father; Jupiter guru-father is a wider reading.

hindi: ऐसे लोग हैं जो भगवान को गालियां बकते फिरते हैं भगवान के तस्वीरों का अपमान करते हैं उन सबका बृहस्पति का कहीं ना कहीं लफड़ा होता है
says: People who curse God or insult pictures of God have a Jupiter problem somewhere in the chart; nature says that is what they will do.
ambiguity: A generalization with no sign or house given.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter afflicted is classically read as lack of faith or disrespect to teachers.

hindi: बाप को गाली बकता है बच्चा मारता भी है शायद तो ये इस प्रकार का दोष है कई दोष है
says: Such a person may also abuse his father, and a child may even hit him; this is one kind of dosha among several.
ambiguity: 'शायद' (perhaps) shows he is not certain.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: सूर्य शनि का भी है सूर्य शनि के दोष में मुख्य बात क्या होती है सूर्य शनि साथ होते हैं अगर शनि अस्त हो गया सूर्य में पावर है अस्त करके डेड कर देता है
says: The Sun-Saturn dosha is another father-related fault; the key point is that if Saturn is combust by the Sun, the Sun's power kills it and the dosha is nullified.
cells_derived_method: The conjunction in any house/sign; a combust Saturn loses strength.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: in the 10th in Aries the Sun is in its best sign and Saturn is in its fall; Saturn is combust and its harm is muted.
Derived: Sun with Saturn in the 7th in Capricorn gives father-like authority in marriage.
Derived: Sun with Saturn in the 4th in Leo is a father-ego conflict at home.

ambiguity: Combustion degree not stated.
classical_check: Partly agrees: a combust planet loses strength; Sun-Saturn is classically a father-son enmity yoga.

hindi: सूर्य शनि साथ होने के बाद भी पिता पुत्र में लड़ाई नहीं होगी वो सेकंड यह बृहस्पति हो जाने से आप अपने पिता के साथ अपमान करोगे झगड़ा होगा टेंशन होगी
says: With a combust Saturn there is no father-son fight even if Sun and Saturn are together; the second case is the Jupiter activation, which makes you insult your father with quarrels and tension.
classical_check: Silent on exact claim.

hindi: उसका सुख नहीं मिलेगा आपको इसलिए बृहस्पति मंदिर जा जा के हाथ भी मत जोड़ो किसी को हाथ जोड़ देना ही बृहस्पति एक्टिवेशन है
says: You will not get the father's happiness, so such a person should not even fold his hands in a temple: folding hands to anyone is itself the Jupiter activation.
classical_check: Differs: classical advice is to honour Jupiter.

hindi: सिर्फ हाथ जोड़ा है मन में भावना लाए सम्मान उसी टाइम बृहस्पति एक्टिवेशन
says: Just folding hands with a feeling of respect in the mind at that moment activates Jupiter.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Mimics such a person who refuses to join hands and says 'to hell with it, I have joined myself, that is enough'.

hindi: शुक्र भी देवता शनि का परम मित्र है बहुत बढ़िया है शनि महाराज तो है ही मेटल दो
says: Venus is also a deity and Saturn's close friend, so it is very good in number 10; Saturn's own items too, so give metal.
cells_derived_method: Venus in Capricorn is in a friend's sign; results appear in the house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Venus in the 7th in Capricorn gives a serious, loyal partner.
Derived: Venus in the 5th in Capricorn gives a restrained but steady romance.
Derived: Venus in the 10th in Capricorn gives career in luxury business with discipline.

classical_check: Agrees: Venus and Saturn are mutual friends; metals are Saturn's.

hindi: बहुत ज्यादा लग रहा है मन में आग लग रही है तो राहु बहुत बढ़िया है यहां केतु बहुत बढ़िया है सब दे दो कोई फर्क नहीं है
says: If your mind is burning with too much agitation, Rahu and Ketu items are very good here, so give them all with no distinction.
ambiguity: The 'mind on fire' trigger is odd; the donation sense is inferred.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Rahu and Ketu do well with Saturn's sign for the Saturn-Rahu connection.

hindi: यूरेनस दे दो नेप्चून दे दो प्लूटो दे दो ये सारी की सारी पूंछ है जो शनि के पीछे बृहस्पति के बाद आपका शनि आ गया मूलाधार उसके नीचे सारे के सारे पूंछ की तरह चले हुए हैं सारे गुड है यहां
says: Uranus, Neptune and Pluto items may be given here: they are a tail following Saturn after Jupiter, below the root chakra, and all are good here.
ambiguity: This reverses his earlier bans on Neptune and Pluto in other slots, because here they follow Saturn.
classical_check: Silent; the outer planets are not classical.

hindi: यहां प्लूटो का बिहेवियर शनि के समान सेम चलेगा बृहस्पति 10 नंबर में नीच का है और 11 नंबर में भी नीच तुल्य ही है
says: Pluto behaves the same as Saturn in this slot; and Jupiter is debilitated in sign 10 and nearly equal to debilitated in sign 11.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in Capricorn is debilitated; in Aquarius he treats it as nearly so.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 5th in Capricorn gives delayed children and doubts in learning.
Derived: Jupiter in the 11th in Aquarius gives gains through groups but with a muted blessing.
Derived: debilitated Jupiter in the 2nd in Capricorn gives frugal wealth and cautious speech.

classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is debilitated in Capricorn; in Aquarius it is neutral, not debilitated.

hindi: मंगल 10 नंबर में उच्च है
says: Mars is exalted in sign 10 (Capricorn); the sentence breaks off and continues on sign 11 in the next slice.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Mars in each house gives strength in that house's topics.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Mars in the 3rd gives high courage and drive.
Derived: exalted Mars in the 6th crushes enemies and debts.
Derived: exalted Mars in the 11th gives strong gains through action.

ambiguity: Truncated at the batch boundary.
classical_check: Agrees: Mars is exalted in Capricorn.

hindi: नंबर में भी उच्च तुल्य ही है वैसा ही फल देगा
says: Mars in sign 11 (Aquarius) is nearly equal to exalted and will give the same kind of result as in sign 10; the sentence continues from the previous slice's break.
cells_derived_method: Mars in Aquarius is read as near-exalted; its strength shows in the house it occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: near-exalted Mars in the 3rd gives courage and enterprise by unconventional means.
Derived: near-exalted Mars in the 6th is strong against enemies and debts.
Derived: near-exalted Mars in the 10th gives drive in technical or group-based careers.

ambiguity: The subject of the sentence is cut: it follows 'मंगल 10 नंबर में उच्च है, 11' from the previous batch, so Mars in sign 11 is inferred.
classical_check: Differs: Mars is exalted only in Capricorn; Aquarius is Saturn's sign, an enemy sign for Mars.

gist: Says results will differ in other places and that is a separate story; for now this much is enough to understand, and a lot will become clear from it.

hindi: 12 नंबर आ गया फिर इसके बाद 12 नंबर के अंदर हमारे पास सूर्य बृहस्पति की और केतु की राशि है
says: Now comes sign 12 (Pisces), which in his scheme belongs to Jupiter and Ketu as lords.
ambiguity: The caption also puts the Sun in the list ('सूर्य बृहस्पति की और केतु की'), which is probably a slip; Pisces has no Sun lordship.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Pisces is Jupiter's sign; Ketu as co-lord is a modern view.

hindi: ये सूर्य एकदम गुड
says: The Sun is very good in number 12 (Pisces, Jupiter's sign).
cells_derived_method: Sun in Pisces is in a friend's sign; houses decide the field.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Sun in the 9th in Pisces gives respect for father and dharma and good fortune.
Derived: Sun in the 12th in Pisces gives spiritual retreat or foreign stay with calm authority.
Derived: Sun in the 5th in Pisces gives refined intelligence and respect from children.

classical_check: Agrees in part: Sun in Pisces is friendly, so good, not exalted.

hindi: चंद्रमा बहुत गुड
says: The Moon is very good in number 12 (Pisces).
cells_derived_method: Moon in Pisces sits in a Jupiter sign, a friend; mind and emotions flourish in the house occupied.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Moon in the 4th in Pisces gives a peaceful, spiritual home and mother.
Derived: Moon in the 1st in Pisces gives a gentle, intuitive and imaginative personality.
Derived: Moon in the 8th in Pisces gives psychic sensitivity and emotional depth.

classical_check: Agrees: Moon is friendly with Jupiter, so Pisces suits it.

hindi: मंगल एकदम गुड
says: Mars is excellent in number 12 (Pisces).
cells_derived_method: Mars in Pisces sits in a friend's sign; it gives energy toward the house topic.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mars in the 3rd in Pisces gives quiet courage and artistic initiative.
Derived: Mars in the 10th in Pisces gives work in healing, defence or hospitality.
Derived: Mars in the 6th in Pisces helps overcome rivals and illness.

classical_check: Agrees in part: Mars is friendly with Jupiter; Pisces is a comfortable sign for it.

hindi: बुध खराब अब यहां बुध महाराज नीच के हो गए
says: Mercury is bad in number 12 (Pisces): it becomes debilitated.
cells_derived_method: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces; intellect, speech and trade are weakened in the house occupied.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 3rd gives vague writing and communication.
Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 10th confuses business and decisions.
Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 2nd gives loose speech and money muddle.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury is debilitated in Pisces.

hindi: क्या करें पूजा पाठ ना करे आदमी मंदिर में जाके अगर रेजगारी धन कैश चढ़ाया तो गया काम से
says: With Mercury debilitated in number 12 the person should not do puja or offer small change or cash at a temple, or he is finished.
ambiguity: 'गया काम से' is an idiom meaning ruined.
classical_check: Differs: Mercury remedies classically include charity of green items and worship.

hindi: क्या करें खाली बैठा रहे यूं ही कहेंगे धरती पे बोझ है लड़का अंधा नोट छापे यूं ही बैठे बैठा सक्सेसफुल होगा कमाल ही है अजीब सी बात है
says: What should he do? Sit idle: people will say the boy is a burden on earth, yet like a blind man printing notes, sitting still he becomes successful, which he finds strange.
cells_derived_method: Debilitated Mercury is not activated; results arise without effort in whichever house it sits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 10th gives rise in career without visible effort.
Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 11th gives gains that arrive without planning.
Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 9th gives fortune through simple living.

ambiguity: A joke-like description of the idle person; the claim is that doing nothing works.
classical_check: Silent; this goes against the Parashari idea that debilitated Mercury needs cancellation or effort.

hindi: यहां तो बुध नीच का बैठा है अब हम बुध नीच के इफेक्ट को डाउन कर रहे हैं लेकिन जैसे यहां पर बुध हमने इसकी पूजा पाठ शुरू करी वाणी के
says: Mercury is debilitated here, and by not stirring it he is trying to bring its bad effect down; but if you start puja through speech, the result flips; the sentence continues in the next block.
ambiguity: Sentence is cut at the block end ('वाणी के').
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: द्वारा मंत्र जाप रिसाइट शुरू करी वाणी दे दी नौवे घर को ऑटोमेटिक बुध की पावर बढ़ जाएगी नीच हो जाएगा तो कुछ कहो क करो ही मत
says: If you begin puja with mantra chanting and recitation, giving your speech to the 9th house, Mercury's power rises automatically and its debilitation takes hold; so neither say nor do anything.
cells_derived_method: Activating Mercury through speech inflates its debilitated effect in the house where it sits; the 9th house is the one fed by prayer.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Mercury debilitated in the 9th made louder by mantra recitation would confuse belief and father relations.
Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 3rd activated by recitation would scatter communication and effort.
Derived: debilitated Mercury in the 7th activated by recitation would blur partnership dealings.

ambiguity: 'नीच हो जाएगा' might mean the debilitation becomes active or Mercury becomes 'more low'.
classical_check: Differs: classical remedies for a debilitated Mercury include mantra and Vishnu worship.

hindi: जितना कम पुरुषार्थ करोगे बुध क्या है वायु हवा ये यहां पर उच्च कम से कम पुरुषार्थ करे बंदा हंसता खेलता रहे उसके पास ऑटोमेटिक भाग्य लाभ होगा
says: The less effort you make the better: Mercury is air, so the person should do minimum effort and stay cheerful, and fortune and gain will come to him automatically.
ambiguity: 'यहां पर उच्च' is unclear; it may refer to the 9th-house fortune effect or to a high placement.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: कोई जरूरत नहीं है उसको पिता का आशीर्वाद चाहिए पिता कुछ भी करे बहस ना करे ऑटोमेटिक आप उसको जीवन में बढ़िया होगा
says: He only needs the father's blessing: whatever the father does, do not argue, and life will go well automatically.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: the father's blessing links to the 9th house and Sun.

hindi: हो सकता है माता-पिता गलत है खराब है बुरे अच्छे नहीं है उसकी लाइफ रॉकेट की तरह उठती चली जाएगी
says: Even if the parents are wrong or bad, the person's life will keep rising like a rocket if he does not argue.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says this works only if the knowledge is followed, and that he will take up the 8th as well later; it is a big saga ('Ramayana'), not small.

hindi: 12 नंबर बृहस्पति टू गुड अपना ही है कोई दिक्कत वाली बात नहीं है
says: Jupiter in number 12 (Pisces) is too good: it is its own sign and there is no problem.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter in its own sign Pisces is strong in any house, giving wisdom to that house.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 2nd gives wealth and wise speech.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 5th gives children, learning and good judgement.
Derived: Jupiter in own sign in the 12th supports spiritual life and charitable spending.

classical_check: Agrees: Pisces is Jupiter's own sign.

hindi: बड़ी मजे की बात है यहां आ गया शुक्र शुक्र हो गया उच्च का
says: Venus arrives in number 12 (Pisces) and is exalted there, which he finds interesting.
cells_derived_method: Venus is exalted in Pisces; house shows where its indulgence and charm act.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Venus in the 7th gives a loving, glamorous partner.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 12th gives bed pleasures, secrecy and foreign comforts.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 10th gives career in arts, luxury or hospitality.

classical_check: Agrees: Venus is exalted in Pisces.

hindi: धर्म स्थान में जितने हम स्कैंडल सुनते हैं सारे यहां है कि यार शुक्र उच्च का हो गया बंदा बस धर्म स्थान में जाके पार्टी करी ऐश प्रस्थ का कार्यक्रम किया पुरुष और स्त्री का संगम का हिसाब किताब बनाया
says: The scandals we hear of at religious places come from this exalted Venus: the person uses the holy place for parties, indulgence, male-female liaisons and money arrangements.
cells_derived_method: Exalted Venus in Pisces tied to a religious setting, with the 9th and 12th houses closest.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Venus in the 9th suggests scandal tied to religious or guru circles.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 12th suggests private indulgence in secluded places.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 5th suggests romance or liaisons in devotional gatherings.

ambiguity: A moral generalization about people; recorded as his claim, no individual is implied.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts link Venus-Jupiter or Venus in the 12th with luxury, not scandal at temples.

hindi: ये सारा का सारा इस शुक्र के दम पे है लेकिन वैभव भयंकर होगा उस आदमी का गजब के कनेक्शंस होंगे और यही कार्य के द्वारा उसका नसीब उठ रहा है
says: All this rests on that Venus, yet the man's opulence will be huge, with great connections, and through exactly this activity his fortune rises.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: exalted Venus in the 11th gives networks and gains from pleasure-linked work.
Derived: exalted Venus in the 2nd gives wealth with luxury lifestyle.

classical_check: Partly agrees: exalted Venus classically gives wealth and comforts.

hindi: लोग कहेंगे यार ये कैसा आदमी है गंदे काम करके उठ रहा है भगवान इसको पाप नहीं देता क्या फल नहीं देता क्या सजा नहीं देता
says: People will ask why God does not punish a man rising through dirty deeds; this is the question that his next explanation answers.
ambiguity: A question he poses, not a claim; kept as context for the karma argument.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हमारे को रूढ़िवादिता के तौर पर सिखाया गया है नहीं नहीं गंदे कर्म अच्छे कर्म कोई कर्म अच्छा और गंदा नहीं है जो जैसे ग्रह की एक्टिवेशन आपने कर ली वैसे होगी
says: He rejects the conventional teaching on good and bad deeds: no deed is inherently good or dirty; the outcome follows whichever planet you have activated.
ambiguity: A philosophical stance contradicting the usual karma teaching.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish ties results to past karma and dharma, not to amoral activation alone.

hindi: कितने लोग आप देखेंगे दो नंबर का काम करके उठ रहे हैं हमारे पास लोग आते हैं जब दसवें घर को लेंगे अगर यह राशि गलत है नीच का ग्रह है कोई नेगेटिविटी है तो वो उठता
says: Many people rise through dubious (number two) work; when the 10th house is examined and its sign is wrong, a debilitated planet or some negativity is present; the thought continues in the next block.
cells_derived_method: A debilitated or afflicted 10th house sign or occupant is the signature he looks for.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: a debilitated Mars in the 10th in Cancer fits his picture of rising by shady means.
Derived: a debilitated Saturn in the 10th in Aries fits it too.
Derived: a debilitated Mercury in the 10th in Pisces fits it for business cunning.

ambiguity: Sentence breaks at the block boundary.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not give this as a rule.

hindi: ही दो नंबर से है वो दो ही नंबर के काम करेगा टैक्स की चोरी करेगा तभी उठ सकता है लाइफ के अंदर
says: Such a person rises only through dubious means and will do dubious work such as tax evasion, because only then can he rise. This is a claim about a pattern, not advice to do it.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Anticipates the objection that this is sin and wrong teaching; says it is wisdom, not education, and that knowledge and gyan are different.

hindi: तो भगवान ऐसे लोगों को सजा क्यों नहीं देता भगवान अलग-अलग किस्म के रूप में काम कर रहा है बहुत सारे रूप है उसके
says: Why does God not punish such people? His answer: God works in many different forms and roles, so the same event is handled by different functions.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Body analogies for 'many forms': the kidney only filters, the liver throws out poison as bile and burns the dirt, the gut holds bacteria and doctors give curd-type probiotics when bad bacteria fall.
Notes that people then plead 'God forgive me' about harming some creature.
Asks the audience not to take offence as he is saying this with some extra swagger; everyone says do not kill any living thing, do not sin, poor creature.

Fever example: total leucocyte count should stay below about 12000-14000, with fever, ESR and CRP up it jumps to 15000-18000; the doctor gives antibiotics, not prayer, charity or Gita recitation. A medical analogy, not an astrological claim.
The antibiotic kills the multiplied germs, each of which is a living organism; so we are killing millions of living beings.
Asks who carries the sin for killing countless microbes inside the body, and says there is no point discussing what we cannot see, as we cannot see God either.
Says religious wars and Hindu-Muslim disputes happen in God's name, though neither God nor Allah has any stake; calls it foolishness and hypnosis placed in the intellect.

hindi: अल्टीमेट रिजल्ट क्या है अराजकता कौन है ये जो हमारे नीचे के दैत्य चल रहे हैं यूरेनस नेप्चून प्लूटो इत्यादि ये मारामारी पे आ रहे हैं
says: The ultimate result is anarchy, and the lower demons Uranus, Neptune and Pluto are the ones driving it, turning to violence and mayhem.
ambiguity: 'नीचे के दैत्य' (the demons below) probably refers to the outer planets, which he places below Saturn and Rahu-Ketu.
classical_check: Silent; the outer planets are not classical.

hindi: सोच भी नहीं सकता इंसान वहां पर बुद्धि काम ही नहीं करती ये सूर्य और चंद्रमा है प्लूटो प क्या है पैर के तले क्या वहां तक दिमाग चल रहा है नो
says: Human beings cannot even think of this: the intellect does not work in the zone of the outer planets. Sun and Moon are at the top, while Pluto is at the soles of the feet, and the mind does not reach down there.
ambiguity: The caption is choppy: 'ये सूर्य और चंद्रमा है प्लूटो प क्या है' is read as a contrast between top and bottom of the body map.
classical_check: Silent; Pluto at the feet continues his body-chakra mapping, not a classical one.

gist: Sentence breaks off ('sometimes we say, let me think with the feet'); continues in the next slice.
Scratching the head, 'I cannot understand, I am not thinking', then 'okay okay'; a pause for the audience before the body-map example.

hindi: दिल से करते हैं प्यार नाभी से खाते हैं खाना पैर से करते क्या है वहा तो प्लूटो है मौत है
says: Body map: we love with the heart and take food at the navel, but the feet, where Pluto and death sit, do no thinking or action of that kind.
ambiguity: The body-part map is his own; the 'feet = Pluto' link continues from the previous batch.
classical_check: Differs: classically the feet belong to the 12th house and Pisces; Pluto is not classical.

hindi: जीवन के अंदर यह सोच का विस्तार होना बहुत जरूरी है कि पाप और पुण्य का स्यापा सारा हिप्नोसिस है इससे ऊपर निकलो
says: It is necessary to widen your thinking: the whole fuss about sin and virtue is hypnosis, so rise above it.
ambiguity: A philosophical stance, tied to his earlier claim that no action is good or bad in itself.
classical_check: Differs: classical Jyotish and dharma texts treat papa and punya as real karmic categories.

hindi: ये वहम जो है यह सारे वहम आपके चंद्रमा का नाश कर देते हैं आपका केतु नष्ट हो जाता है वहमी व्यक्ति किसी किस्म के वहम में आप पढ़ोगे मारे जाओगे
says: Superstitions and delusions destroy your Moon and wreck your Ketu; a person caught in them, and anyone who falls for such beliefs, is ruined.
ambiguity: 'मारे जाओगे' is figurative ruin, not a death prediction.
classical_check: Partly agrees: Moon is the mind and its affliction gives fear and doubt; Ketu with confusion is a standard reading.

gist: Quip that anyone who thinks 'never again' after taking antibiotics should also throw the racket out of the house, since it kills mosquitoes; ends with 'Hari Om'.

hindi: शनि महाराज आ गए शनि वही ब्लॉकेज वाला है शनि का अगर आप सामान देते हैं कोई दिक्कत नहीं है नेगेटिव नहीं है क्योंकि ये केतु की राशि है
says: Saturn now arrives in number 12 (Pisces): he is the blockage planet, yet giving Saturn's items here is fine and not negative, because this is Ketu's sign.
ambiguity: The slot is the 9th-house donation framework he just finished; the sign cell is the number 12 slot.
classical_check: Silent; Ketu as Pisces lord is not classical.

hindi: बृहस्पति का लफड़ा मत लो पर बृहस्पति एक्टिवेटेड होता है यहां उसका कार्य होता है
says: Do not take Jupiter's trouble into account here, even though Jupiter does get activated in this sign and does its work.
ambiguity: Caption is choppy ('पर बति'); the meaning is partly inferred.
classical_check: Agrees that Jupiter, own-sign lord of Pisces, is active there.

hindi: शनि का सामान आप दे सकते हो कोई दिक्कत नहीं है राहु का सामान आप दे सकते हो कोई दिक्कत नहीं है
says: Both Saturn's and Rahu's items may be given in number 12 without any difficulty.
classical_check: Silent; Saturn and Rahu donation is classical, though not specific to Pisces.

hindi: शनि हो गया राहु हो गया केतु तो है ही है दैट इज परफेक्टली फाइन
says: Saturn, Rahu and of course Ketu are all perfectly fine for this slot.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Announces the 9th house is now complete for today and that he now takes up the 5th house.
Says it makes no difference how much the world honours or insults you; what matters is how much you honour or insult yourself, so he will applaud himself.

hindi: यह आपका पंचम भाव है जी फाइव नंबर यह आपका भाव पितरों का भाव है
says: The 5th house is the house of the ancestors (pitaras).
cells_derived_method: The sign in the 5th shows which kind of ancestral grace: sign nature times the house meaning.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo in the 5th shows grace of ancestors flowing through authority and status.
Derived: Cancer in the 5th shows ancestral grace through the mother's line.
Derived: Capricorn in the 5th shows ancestral grace through duty, work and discipline.

ambiguity: Ancestors are usually the 9th house; here he gives the 5th.
classical_check: Partly differs: the 5th is purva punya (past merit) and the 9th is father and lineage; he joins them.

hindi: यह लगन हो गया एक नंबर यह पांच ये नौ एक पांच और नौ इसके ऊपर मलकीत बृहस्पति की रहती है
says: The houses 1, 5 and 9 (the trines) are under Jupiter's ownership and control.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter's influence shows in each trine, with the sign of the house colouring the result.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Jupiter's grace on the 1st in Gemini works through learning and communication.
Derived: Jupiter's grace on the 5th in Sagittarius is strong, as it is Jupiter's own sign.
Derived: Jupiter's grace on the 9th in Scorpio works through research and hidden knowledge.

ambiguity: 'मलकीत' is read as 'ownership' (मालिकी).
classical_check: Partly agrees: Jupiter is the natural karaka of the 5th and 9th; the 1st is Sun's and lagna lord's, not Jupiter's.

hindi: बृहस्पति ही अपने आप में गुरु है जिसके राजा भी सम्मान करता है जिसके दम पर धरती पर जीवन है
says: Jupiter is the Guru, honoured even by kings, and life on earth rests on his strength.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the guru and preceptor of the gods.

hindi: आपका जो नाभी केंद्र है वो आपका मणिपुर चक्र है उसके ठीक नीचे स्वाधिष्ठान स्व अधिष्ठाता खुद का अधिष्ठाता जो मैं हूं
says: The navel centre is the Manipura chakra, and just below it is Svadhishthana, meaning the presiding self, the 'I am' centre.
ambiguity: The chakra naming is standard tantra, not astrological.
classical_check: Silent on chakras; consistent with common yogic descriptions.

hindi: जो स्पर्म और एग बनते हैं उसका चक्र स्वाधिष्ठान चक्र है और वहां का जो मालिक है वो बृहस्पति
says: Svadhishthana is the chakra tied to the making of sperm and egg, and its master is Jupiter.
ambiguity: A body-and-chakra claim, not a medical statement.
classical_check: Differs: Jupiter as lord of Svadhishthana is not classical; Jupiter is the karaka of children, which loosely matches.

hindi: जीवन में जो भी आप नया बना रहे हैं संतान शब्द को ना लेकर चले कि एक बच्चा पैदा हुआ उसके अतिरिक्त कुछ भी आप बना रहे हैं चीजें तो भी बृहस्पति महाराज की कृपा से होता है
says: Do not read 'santan' as only a child: anything new you create in life, any thing you build, happens by Jupiter's grace.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 5th is creativity and purva punya; widening to all creation is his own.

hindi: यह पांचवा घर कृपा का खाना है यहां पर कृपा मिलती है कृपा का अर्थ समझ ले यह देवता की कृपा है और यह पित्रों की कृपा है
says: The 5th house is the house (khana) of grace: here grace is received, namely the grace of the deities and the grace of the ancestors.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th shows through what channel the grace arrives.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 5th suggests grace comes through initiative and Mars-type deities.
Derived: Taurus in the 5th suggests grace through comfort and family assets.
Derived: Pisces in the 5th suggests grace through devotion and Jupiter's blessing.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is the house of purva punya and divine grace (mantra, ishta devata).

hindi: एक मेहनत की कृपा होती है यह मेहनत की कृपा है यह इन्हेरिटेंस की कृपा है
says: There are different kinds of grace: the grace of hard work and the grace of inheritance, each from a different house.
ambiguity: He points at the board; which house is effort and which is inheritance is not audible. Classically effort is the 10th or 6th and inheritance the 8th.
classical_check: Classical houses suggest 6/10 for effort and 8 for inheritance; his mapping is lost.

hindi: यह पति या पत्नी यानी किसी लड़की के भाग्य में ग्रह अच्छा हो गया तो वह कंगाल घर में पैदा हो के भी रानी की तरह आगे घर को भी रजवाड़ा बना देती है
says: The grace of the spouse: if a girl has a good planet in her fortune, even if born in a poor home she lives like a queen and turns her new home into a palace.
cells_derived_method: The spouse's grace sits in the 7th; a strong sign and planet there lifts the family.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Libra in the 7th with a good planet supports a refined, wealthy spouse and an elevated home.
Derived: Taurus in the 7th suggests a spouse bringing material comfort.
Derived: Capricorn in the 7th suggests a spouse bringing status through effort and duty.

ambiguity: The house is not named in the caption; the 7th is assumed from the word 'spouse'.
classical_check: Agrees: the 7th and its lord decide the spouse's fortune effect.

hindi: ये लड़का ऐसा हो सकता है कंगाल हो लेकिन शादी होने के बाद खुद राजा के समान श्रेष्ठ हो जाए
says: Likewise a boy who is penniless can become like a king after marriage, through the spouse's grace.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Leo in the 7th with a strong planet gives marriage that raises social standing.
Derived: Sagittarius in the 7th gives a fortunate, learned spouse who lifts luck.

ambiguity: The 7th is inferred, as above.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: a strong 7th brings rise through marriage.

hindi: यह उनकी ऐसे ऐसे अलग-अलग कृपा हैं ये कार्य स्थान की कृपा है कार्य ये ससुराल बहुत मजे की बात है
says: More kinds of grace come from different houses: the grace of the workplace and of the in-laws, house by house on the board.
cells_derived_method: Each house is the source of one kind of grace; the sign on it tells its tone.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Capricorn on the 10th gives workplace grace through discipline.
Derived: Libra on the 7th gives in-law grace through refinement.

ambiguity: The mapping of which house is workplace and which is in-laws is pointed at, not spoken. Classically the 10th is work and the 7th or 4th is the in-laws.
classical_check: Silent on exact mapping from the caption.

hindi: शत्रु की भी बड़ी कृपा होती है शमशान भी यही है शत्रु जब लड़ के जाता है आपके ब्रेन के न्यूरो कनेक्शन चेंज करता है और शॉक थेरेपी देकर आपको बदलता है
says: The enemy too gives grace: the cremation ground sits in the same house, and when an enemy fights you he changes your brain's neural connections and works like shock therapy to change you.
cells_derived_method: The 6th house, enemies, is read as a house of beneficial shock; the sign shows the type of enemy.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 6th gives a direct, combative enemy who forces quick change.
Derived: Virgo in the 6th gives critical, detail-driven opposition that improves your methods.
Derived: Scorpio in the 6th gives secretive rivals and deep transformation through conflict.

ambiguity: The house of enemies is the 6th in standard Jyotish; he points to it. The cremation ground belongs classically to the 8th, so 'शमशान भी यही' suggests he is pointing at the 6th or the 8th.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 6th is enemies; the cremation ground is classically the 8th or 12th.

hindi: बदलने के लिए यही एक खाना है इसको बुरा ना समझे हमने एक शत्रु मात्र लिख दिया इसके अंदर ऐसे ही आपके धन का है मित्र का है मित्र यहां भी होते हैं
says: This house is the one that changes you, so do not call it bad; he has merely labelled it 'enemy', but it also holds wealth and friends: friends too sit here.
ambiguity: It is unclear which house he refers to for wealth and friends; the board labels are lost.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 2nd is wealth and the 11th friends; the 6th gives service and gains from enemies.

hindi: माता यहां है पिता की कृपा बड़ा भाई बड़ा बिजनेस और यह भोग आपके भोग विलास रोग बीमारी अस्पताल के खर्चे
says: The mother's grace has its place, then the father's grace, the elder brother and big business; and another house covers pleasure, luxury, illness and hospital expenses.
cells_derived_method: Mother is the 4th, father the 9th (or 10th), elder brother the 11th, business the 10th, pleasure, illness and hospital spending the 12th, as in standard Jyotish; the order and board mapping is not audible.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Cancer on the 4th gives a strong, caring mother grace.
Derived: Aquarius on the 11th gives grace from elder siblings, friends and large networks.
Derived: Gemini on the 12th gives spending on pleasures and travel with scattered health matters.

ambiguity: Cells are inferred from standard house meanings; his sentence names the topics only.
classical_check: Agrees with standard house significations.

hindi: ये स्वयं खुद की खुद की कृपा अब ये इतनी सारी कृपा हों का खाना है कृपा यहीं से मिलेगी एक्टिवेशन यहां से होगा
says: Self-grace is also on the list (the 1st house), and the 5th house is where all these graces are kept: grace will be received from here once the 5th is activated.
ambiguity: Which house is 'self' is pointed at; the 1st is the usual self house.
classical_check: Partly agrees: the 5th is the seat of purva punya, from which graces flow.

hindi: यहां से मिलनी शुरू करेगी जहां-जहां से जिस जिस की जो मिलनी है ये पांचवां खाना ही आपका वो खाना है
says: Grace will begin to flow from every place it is due once the 5th is activated; the 5th house is the compartment from which the other graces are released.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: जो खाना शब्द इस्तेमाल कर रहे हैं यानी कि भाव 12 खाने हैं 12 भाव है
says: He explains his term: 'khana' means bhava (house), and there are 12 khanas or houses.
ambiguity: 'खाना' is the Lal Kitab or Nadi-style word for a house box.
classical_check: Agrees: 12 bhavas; 'khana' is the Lal Kitab usage.

hindi: ये पांचवा भाव जो है यह भाव आपके जीवन के अंदर विद्या देता है पितरों की कृपा देता है आपको संतान देता है आपके प्रजनन की क्षमता को सेट करता है
says: The 5th house gives education, the ancestors' grace and children, and sets your reproductive capacity.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th tints learning, children and fertility.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Gemini on the 5th favours study of communication, a few clever children and light fertility.
Derived: Scorpio on the 5th gives research-oriented education and intense or delayed progeny.
Derived: Sagittarius on the 5th gives higher learning, good fortune with children and strong fertility.

classical_check: Agrees: the 5th is vidya, santan and purva punya; fertility is part of the 5th.

hindi: इसी के पास आपका कमर का एरिया है एक साइड एक किडनी इधर है एक किडनी इधर है लिवर पैंक्रियास स्टमक इंटेस्टाइन साथ आ गए ये सारा का सारा एरिया है
says: The body area of the 5th is the waist and upper abdomen: both kidneys, liver, pancreas, stomach and intestines come together there. A body-region claim recorded as his statement, not a medical finding.
cells_derived_method: The sign on the 5th would point to which organ of this region is stressed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Virgo on the 5th points to the digestive tract of this region.
Derived: Libra on the 5th points to kidneys and the lower back.
Derived: Leo on the 5th points to the heart and upper abdomen.

classical_check: Differs: classically the 5th is the stomach and heart region, the 6th the intestines and the 7th the kidney area; Kalapurusha gives Leo the heart and Virgo the abdomen.

hindi: हमारा शरीर एक रीड की हड्डी प खड़ा है कंधे ये हड्डी पेल्विक गडल की बीच में एक डंडा है स्केलेटन का उस डंडे के साथ मास है फ्लेश है फैट है उसने महत्वपूर्ण अंगों को पकड़ के रखा हुआ है
says: The body stands on the spine between the shoulder and the pelvic girdle, and flesh, muscle and fat attached to this skeleton hold the vital organs firmly in place.
ambiguity: An anatomy description supporting why the 5th region is so central.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: हम दौड़ रहे हैं भाग रहे हैं लेट रहे हैं कहीं ऐसे नहीं लुड़क रहे इधर-उधर हार्ट भी यही है फंसी हुई है बीच में कितनी खूबसूरती से शरीर को मेंटेन करा के दिया है
says: The organs stay in place whether we run, lie or roll about, and the heart is also in this region, held in between; this is the beautiful maintenance that grace provides.
classical_check: Agrees that the 5th is a heart house.

hindi: ये कृपा जब हिल जाती है तो ये सब में कुछ ना कुछ हिल जाता है
says: When this grace is shaken, something in all of these body parts and life areas gets shaken as well.
cells_derived_method: An afflicted 5th house sign or occupant unsettles the region and the graces it holds.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: an afflicted 5th in Scorpio unsettles digestion and the line of children.
Derived: an afflicted 5th in Capricorn weighs on education and the stomach with delay.

ambiguity: A general health-flavoured claim; not a diagnosis.
classical_check: Agrees in outline: an afflicted 5th disturbs children, intellect and the stomach region.

hindi: जब भी आपकी लाइफ में कोई प्रॉब्लम है पहले तो देवता की कृपा ले लो उसके बाद पितरों की कृपा ले लो सारी कृपा यहां ठहरी हुई है
says: Whenever life has a problem, first take the grace of the deities, then the grace of the ancestors; all grace is stored in the 5th house.
classical_check: Agrees in spirit: ishta devata and pitru worship as general remedies.

hindi: आपको कुछ भी समझ नहीं आ रहा आप जच्छी भी नहीं हो ढंग के पर ये दो खाने भी आपने सेट कर लिए तो फर्स्ट एड तो हो ही जाएगी
says: Even if you understand nothing, if you set these two houses right you at least get first aid in life.
ambiguity: 'ये दो खाने' is read as the 5th and the 9th, which he has just paired as the houses of grace.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक इमरजेंसी होती है ना घर के पड़ोस में नर्सिंग होम फिर हॉस्पिटल चले जाओ खास स्पेशलिटी के लिए यह सारा कृपा का खेला यहां से चलता है
says: As an emergency is treated at a nearby nursing home before a specialist hospital, so the whole play of grace starts from this house first.
ambiguity: An analogy; no specific rule beyond the sequence.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां पर यह पहला चौथा पांचवा यह आपका पंचम भाव बैठ गया और यहां से हम सेम जैसे वहां चला है वैसे ही एक दो तीन चार पांच छह सात सारी राशियों का हिसाब किताब स्कूल से लेंगे

Derived: the 5th house in Taurus takes Venus-type gifts at a school.
Derived: the 5th house in Gemini takes Mercury-type gifts at a school.

ambiguity: 'पहला चौथा पांचवा' (1st, 4th, 5th) is ambiguous; he seems to be pointing to a diagram.
classical_check: Silent; a donation method of his own.

hindi: स्कूल शिक्षा संस्थान आप सारे दान जो धर्म स्थान में कर रहे थे वैसे ही डिट्टो दान आप सारे के सारे चैरिटेबल स्कूल में करेंगे
says: For the 5th house, the same donations you made at religious places are made at charitable schools and educational institutions instead.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: एक नंबर राशि आ गई मंगल कोई चैरिटेबल स्कूल देख लो अंध विद्यालय वगैरह भोजन दे दो लाल चीज दे दो लाल ईट दे दो
says: Sign 1 (Aries, Mars) in the 5th: at a charitable school such as a school for the blind, give food, red items and red bricks.
cells_derived_method: Aries on the 5th means a Sagittarius lagna, with Mars lording the 5th and 12th; the same red gifts would change focus in other houses.

derived_examples.reading: Derived: Aries in the 9th (Leo lagna) turns the same red gift towards dharma and father.
Derived: Aries in the 10th (Cancer lagna) turns it to career and authority.
Derived: Aries in the 2nd (Pisces lagna) turns it to wealth and speech.

ambiguity: 'एक नंबर राशि' is read as Aries in the 5th house, per his method; the house is carried over from the previous sentences.
classical_check: Silent; red items are a classical Mars donation.

hindi: इसी का मित्र बृहस्पति भी है पीली भी दे सकते हो आप वो भी बहुत बढ़िया रहेगी इसी का मित्र और कौन है आपका साथ में सूर्य हो गया मंगल हो गया बृहस्पति हो गया
says: Jupiter is a friend of Mars, so yellow items are very good too; the friends of Mars here are the Sun and Jupiter, so all three planets' items work.

hindi: ये सब दे सकते हैं गेहूं दे सकते हैं आप आटा दे सकते हैं या लोहे की सरिया नहीं दे सकते शनि की नेगेटिविटी हो जाएगी
says: For this slot you may give wheat and flour, but not iron rods, since that brings Saturn's negativity.
classical_check: Differs: iron is a Saturn donation advised for Saturn problems, but he forbids it in Mars's slot.

hindi: इसी प्रकार दो नंबर है घी दे दो कपड़ा दे दो साजो सामान दे दो अगर कोई चैरिटेबल स्कूल दिखता है

says: Sign 3 (Gemini, Mercury) in the 5th: give stationery to children, since all stationery belongs to Mercury: notebooks, books, pencils.

Derived: Gemini in the 10th (Virgo lagna) turns it towards business.

says: At a school for the blind, Braille items, Braille watches and books are suitable Mercury stationery gifts.

gist: Mimics people who say they have worn themselves out going to temples and the god is still not listening.
Examples of people who tried allopathy, two years of homeopathy and ayurveda with no cure, so 'god is not listening'.

hindi: भगवान नहीं सुन रहा पि सुनेंगे भगवान की पूजा छोड़ दो पितरों की करो
says: When prayers to a deity bring no result, he tells the person to drop deity worship for now and worship the ancestors (pitra) instead.
ambiguity: 'पि सुनेंगे' is garbled; read as 'pitra will listen'.
classical_check: Differs from mainstream practice, which adds shraddha for ancestors but does not tell people to stop deity worship.

gist: Says people bristle when asked if they worship ancestors and answer 'which ancestors, we go to the temple'; they simply do not know.

hindi: जहां भगवान नहीं देगा तुम्हारा पित कृपा रुकी हुई है तुम्हारे को पित्रों से कृपा लेनी पड़ेगी
says: Where the deity gives nothing, he reads it as the ancestors' grace being held back, so the favour has to be obtained from the pitras rather than the god.
ambiguity: 'तुम्हारा पित' is truncated; probably 'tumhara pitra (kripa) ruki hui hai'.
classical_check: Silent; pitra-rina as a cause of obstruction appears in later texts, not in BPHS as stated.

hindi: भगवान की पूजा पाठ छोड़ दो भगवान नाराज नहीं होगा ना क्योंकि भगवान नहीं सुन रहा
says: He reassures that stopping the usual deity puja will not anger god, because the god is not responding anyway, so the effort is better moved to ancestors.
ambiguity: Could mean pause temporarily or stop permanently; he does not say.
classical_check: Contradicts the usual view that daily worship should continue; no classical text backs stopping it.

hindi: तुम हो सकता है एंटी इट की पूजा कर रहे हो गलत देवता को के मंदिर जाकर फूल चढ़ा रहे हो
says: Another reason for no result: you may be worshipping the wrong deity, going to a temple and offering flowers that do not match the planet that actually needs help.
ambiguity: 'एंटी इट की' is garbled; taken as 'wrong' or 'opposite' deity from the following words 'गलत देवता'.
classical_check: Consistent with the idea of choosing deity by the afflicted graha (devata-karaka), which classical remedies texts also teach.

hindi: आपने पीले फूल चढ़ाए बृहस्पति सफेद फूल चढ़ाए चंद्रमा शुक्र आपने लाल फूल चढ़ाए मंगल
says: Flower colour maps to planet: yellow flowers feed Jupiter, white flowers feed Moon or Venus, red flowers feed Mars, so the wrong colour strengthens the wrong planet.
classical_check: Colour-planet links (yellow Jupiter, white Moon/Venus, red Mars) agree with standard karaka lists.

gist: Says which flowers one is offering is a separate story and moves on.

hindi: पितरों की कृपा लो यानी आपकी वंशावली में प्रॉब्लम हो रही है आप संतान से दुखी हो संतान हमसे पैदा हुई हम अपने बाप से दुखी हैं अपनी मां से दुखी हैं पितरों का दोष है
says: Trouble in the family line (vanshavali), shown as unhappiness with your own children and with your own father or mother, is labelled pitra dosha and is the case for taking ancestors' grace.
cells_derived_method: Children link to the 5th, father to the 9th (or 10th in some schemes) and mother to the 4th; he treats distress in all three as one ancestral signal. The sign on each of those houses would decide which planet is the channel.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Moon-ruled 4th with a troubled mother relation would be the maternal-line side of the same ancestral signal.
Derived, not said by him: Jupiter-ruled 9th carrying strain would be the father-side or guru-line side of the same signal.

ambiguity: The sentence starts in the 1:08:06 chunk and ends in the 1:09:03 chunk; he does not name houses here, 5th is inferred from 'children'.
classical_check: Pitra dosha is a later-tradition concept tied to Sun/Rahu or 9th-house afflictions; he stays general and gives no chart test here.

hindi: आपके घर में डब् व के अंदर प्रॉब्लम है साउथ वेस्ट का एरिया में
says: He links the ancestors' problem to a defect in the home's vastu, specifically the south-west area of the house.
ambiguity: 'डब् व' is a garbled caption; likely 'vastu' but could be 'W1' since the next sentence names W1.
classical_check: Vastu texts do assign the south-west to Nairiti and ancestors; this is from vastu, not jyotish.

hindi: साउथ वेस्ट में s8 और w1 होता है
says: In his direction grid the south-west zone is made up of two segments, S8 and W1, meaning the end of the south side and the start of the west side.
ambiguity: The S/W numbering scheme is not explained in this chunk; presumably a 16- or 32-segment direction grid.
classical_check: Silent; this is a vastu-grid convention, not in jyotish classics.

hindi: अगर आपका डब् व खराब है आपको सीधा देख लेना आपके घर के अंदर साउथ वेस्ट एंट्री है या साउथ वेस्ट में गंदगी पड़ी है साउथ वेस्ट में नीला रंग है
says: To test it, look at the south-west of the home: an entrance there, dirt lying there, or blue colour there each count as a defect that points to ancestral dosha.
ambiguity: 'डब् व' again garbled (vastu or W1).
classical_check: A south-west entrance and clutter are standard vastu faults; blue as a fault is his own claim.

hindi: साउथ वेस्ट के अंदर आपका लाल रंग है वो भी नेगेटिव ही है हरा वो भी नेगेटिव है यानी पितरों का दोष न हो गया है
says: Red or green colour in the south-west is also counted as negative, so any of these colour or entrance faults there add up to a confirmed pitra dosha.
ambiguity: He does not name planets; Mars and Mercury are inferred from red and green only.
classical_check: Silent; colour rules for south-west vary between vastu schools.

hindi: अब आपको पांचवें घर के दान करके ठीक होगा
says: The cure for this ancestral problem is donation done for the 5th house, the house of children and past-life merit.
cells_derived_method: The kind of gift depends on the sign on the 5th house, which he lists in the following sentences (signs 1 to 8 given in this batch).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with Taurus on the 5th the gift should lean to Venus items such as cloth, ghee and fragrance.
Derived, not said by him: with Gemini on the 5th the gift should be Mercury items such as stationery and green things.

ambiguity: 'पांचवें घर के दान' could mean donation for the 5th-house sign, or donation made to 5th-house natives (children); the next lines suggest both.
classical_check: Purva-punya from the 5th house is classical, but donating for it is a tradition remedy not in BPHS.

hindi: कोई स्कूल छाट लो कुछ भी नहीं समझ आ रहा स्कूल जाने वाले छोटे बच्चे पकड़ लो
says: If nothing else is clear, pick any school and make school-going small children the recipients of the donation.
classical_check: Silent; feeding or giving to children is a common folk remedy for 5th house.

hindi: चालू भाषा में कहा जाता है 8 साल तक का जो पुरुष बच्चा है वह मंगल है
says: In everyday terms, a boy up to about 8 years old is to be treated as Mars.
ambiguity: He says 'चालू भाषा', so it is a popular framing, not a formal rule.
classical_check: Classical karakas make Mercury the child planet; Mars as boy under 8 is his own usage.

hindi: वह चूंकि उसका अभी तक वीर्य उत्पादन नहीं हुआ वीर्य नहीं बना शरीर के अंदर तो वो शुद्ध है
says: Reason given: since the boy has not yet produced semen he is still pure, which is why gifts to him count as clean offerings.
classical_check: Purity before puberty is a Dharmashastra idea (pre-upanayana child), not a jyotish rule.

hindi: ऐसे कंजक है कंजक मींस जिसको अभी तक रजस्वला नहीं हुई मंथ की डेट चालू नहीं हुई
says: The same holds for girls: a kanjak is a girl who has not yet started menstruating, and she too counts as pure for the donation.
classical_check: Kanjak worship is a Navaratri tradition; the link to 5th house is his own.

hindi: ये वाले बच्चे जो है सारे के सारे पांचवे भाव के हैं
says: All these pre-puberty boys and girls belong to the 5th house, so giving to them is a way of serving the 5th house.
classical_check: 5th as the house of children is classical; restricting it to pre-puberty children is his own.

hindi: इन बच्चों को सामान दो चीजें दो पांच नंबर चार नंबर राशि है
says: Give these children goods, and the type of goods is decided by the sign number involved, with signs 5 and 4 mentioned first before the full list is walked through.
cells_derived_method: The gift type changes with the sign on the 5th house; he later gives sign-wise lists from sign 1 to sign 8.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: with Cancer on the 5th, the later list gives Jupiter things such as books and yellow items.
Derived, not said by him: with Libra on the 5th, the later list gives Saturn and Venus things such as cloth and iron items.

ambiguity: 'पांच नंबर चार नंबर राशि है' is unclear: could be sign 5 and 4, or '5th house, sign number any'. Also unclear if the sign is that of the 5th house or the child's own sign.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब आप टॉफी नहीं दे सकते इन बच्चों को मंगल है मीठा चॉकलेट आप टॉफी दोगे उनको यह पांचवा घर और खराब हो जाएगा आपके और बुरे दिन आ जाएंगे
says: Do not give these children toffee or sweet candy; sweets are Mars-natured and giving them damages the 5th house further and brings worse days.
ambiguity: He mixes 'chocolate' and 'toffee' in one breath; in the next chunk chewed chocolate is allowed and sucking candy is the worse one.
classical_check: Silent; sweets as Mars is his own mapping and he partly contradicts it a minute later.

gist: Imagined objection: 'but we are only giving the children love'; he asks why love, not water.

hindi: प्यार पानी पिलाओ इन्हें इनको राइस खिलाओ सफेद चीज दो सफेद वस्त्र दो इनको सफेद कपड़े सिलवा
says: Instead of sweets, give the children water to drink, feed them rice, and give white things, white clothes or stitched white garments, which are Moon and Venus items.
ambiguity: The moon/venus link is inferred from white, rice and water; he does not name planets here.
classical_check: Water, rice and white are standard Moon/Venus items; as a 5th-house remedy it is his own.

gist: Repeats: give these things to the children and under no circumstances give the sweets.

hindi: यहां पांच नंबर राशि है एक है पांच है आठ है सब में मंगल अच्छा है
says: For the 5th-house sign being 1, 5 or 8 (Aries, Leo or Scorpio), Mars-type gifts are fine, so the chocolate or sweet remedy is acceptable there.
cells_derived_method: Mars is own in Aries and Scorpio and friendly in Leo (Sun's sign), so he calls it good in those; in other signs Mars is neutral or hostile, so the sweet gift is not endorsed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Taurus is Venus-ruled and Mars is a non-friend there, so he would steer to Venus gifts, not sweets.
Derived, not said by him: Mars is exalted in Capricorn, which he did not list, so this is a gap in his list.

ambiguity: 'पांच नंबर राशि है एक पांच आठ' is unclear: could be signs 1, 5, 8 or houses; the later sign-wise list makes signs most likely.
classical_check: Mars good in Aries, Scorpio, Leo is classical (own or friend); Capricorn exaltation is omitted by him.

hindi: सादा सा उपाय चॉकलेट एक चूसने वाली गोली होती है कैंडी उससे अच्छा चॉकलेट जो चपा चपा के खा रहे हैं हम
says: The simple remedy is chocolate, and he separates it from candy: candy is a sucking pill, whereas chocolate that is chewed is the better item to give.
ambiguity: This softens his earlier warning on toffee; the chewing versus sucking distinction is the only difference.
classical_check: Silent; invented remedy distinction.

gist: Banter with the audience about how nice chewing chocolate feels.

hindi: तो वो चॉकलेट चबाए चॉकलेट चबाने बच्चों को दिया आपने यह मजा आ गया
says: Handing out chewable chocolate to the children is declared a satisfying and workable remedy in itself.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Says he will later detail the child's own sign and the study-related remedies; for now only the chocolate remedy.

hindi: अभी तो हम कहते हैं बेटा चॉकलेट ले जाना और अपने जितने भी साथी सहेली बच्चे हैं ना उनको चॉकलेट दे देना पेपर से पहले
says: Exam remedy: the child carries chocolate to school and shares it with all classmates before the paper starts.
classical_check: Silent; a 5th-house (education) folk remedy.

hindi: पता नहीं कहां से उसका नशिया जाता है बच्चे का पेन चलता है और नंबर आ जाते हैं
says: Claimed result of the chocolate sharing: the child's pen flows well in the exam and good marks come, though he does not explain the mechanism.
ambiguity: 'नशिया' is garbled, probably 'nasha' or 'blessing' effect.
classical_check: Silent; anecdotal outcome claim, not verified.

hindi: अब लोग हैरान होते हैं इसमें हैरानी की बात नहीं है ऐसे बहुत से लोग हैं 24 ही घंटे तो है एक दिन में किसी के एक्स्ट्रा तो है नहीं तो किसी को बहुत सफल कैसे कर दिया
says: Everyone gets the same 24 hours, so unusual success of some people cannot be explained by extra time or effort, and he says it must come from grace.
ambiguity: The sentence runs across the 1:10:08 and 1:11:02 chunks.
classical_check: Silent; a general argument, not a chart rule.

hindi: अब कहते हैं लोग मोदी जी 18 घंटे काम करते हैं मोदी जी कितने घंटे काम करते हैं फाइट नहीं है मोदी जी पे है कृपा
says: People say a named political leader works 18 hours; he rejects this as the explanation and says the leader simply has grace on him. This is a claim about a living public figure, recorded as stated, not verified.
ambiguity: 'फाइट नहीं है' likely means 'fight/effort is not it'.
classical_check: Silent; no chart evidence is given.

hindi: वो साक्षात उनके साथ कोई ना कोई स्पिरिट बॉडी चल रही है वो उसी दौरान में सारे काम पेल देते हैं फिर वो रात 2 बजे जगे चाहे चार
says: He claims that some spirit body walks with that leader, and during that time the work gets done, so he can be awake at 2 or 4 at night.
ambiguity: 'साक्षात' and 'स्पिरिट बॉडी' mean a literal accompanying presence in his usage, not a metaphor.
classical_check: Silent; this is his own claim and cannot be tested from a chart.

hindi: अच्छा इतनी देर तक जगने की ताकत कहां से आती है यह व स्पिरिट बॉडी कर रही है तो यह कृपा है यह कृपा है
says: Stamina to stay awake for hours is credited to the spirit body, and that backing is what he defines as kripa.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Garbled lines about a temple getting media coverage and mental devotion to Ram; the claim being made is not clear.

hindi: उनको पितरों की बड़ी असीम कृपा है माता की खूब सेवा करी उन्होंने
says: He attributes that leader's rise to the ancestors' large grace and to long service of his mother, tying ancestor favour and mother-care to worldly success.
cells_derived_method: Mother is the 4th house and Moon karaka, so serving the mother would be the 4th-house action that earns grace; the sign on the 4th shows which planet carries it.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: a Moon-ruled 4th makes mother-service the direct channel of grace.
Derived, not said by him: Venus-ruled 4th would link grace to comfort, home and mother together.

ambiguity: The 4th house and Moon are inferred; he only says 'mother'.
classical_check: 4th as mother and Moon as karaka are classical; the success claim is his own.

gist: Disclaims that he is only observing and has not sworn it will be so, but insists the man has grace.
Says a foreign head of state's troubles are tales, and that he is shielded by immunity because a president cannot be jailed after a big majority win.

hindi: कोई कृपा ई है ना जो उस बंदे को बचाए बैठी है अरबो खरबों पति आदमी है जेल नहीं जा रहा और सारे केस ही केस हो पड़े यह कृपा जब साथ
says: He says some grace must be shielding that rich man from jail despite many cases, offered as a case study of how kripa protects a person from consequences.
ambiguity: The sentence continues into the next chunk; 'कृपा ई है' is garbled.
classical_check: Silent; no chart test given and it concerns a named public figure.

hindi: जब साथ चलती है ना तो आपकी गाड़ी का भयंकर एक्सीडेंट होता है और आप कहते हैं बंदा जिंदा बच नहीं सकता और वही बंदा कह रहा होता भाई मैं चला रहा था किसने बचा लिया उसे यह है कृपा
says: When grace travels with a person, even a terrible car crash that onlookers think fatal is survived; the survivor cannot explain who saved him, and that is what he calls kripa.
classical_check: Silent; the idea of protection from accident resembles the Ayushya or Jupiter protection ideas but he names no planet.

hindi: इसलिए आपको छोटे बच्चों को स्कूल जाते बच्चों को पढ़ने वाले जितने हैं
says: Hence the practical conclusion: direct the grace-earning gifts to small children and to all those who are studying.
ambiguity: The sentence trails into the next one without a verb.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: ऐसा नहीं कि बड़े हो गए 18 20 साल तो हम ये कहे रजस्वला हो चुकी है लड़की या लड़का जो है वो बड़ा हो चुका है युवा है तो कोई बात नहीं आप उन बच्चों को भी दे सकते हैं
says: The giving is not limited to pre-puberty children; even 18 to 20 year old students who are already grown can receive the gifts and the remedy still works.
ambiguity: Relaxes his earlier purity argument about pre-puberty children; he does not reconcile the two.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लेकिन देना क्या है आप उनको साजो सामान के तौर पे एक नंबर राशि है तो लाल रंग की चीजें सूर्य की चीज भोजन का हिसाब किताब ये सब दे सकते हैं
says: If the sign number is 1 (Aries), give red items, Sun items and food supplies to the students.

Derived, not said by him: Aries on the 10th links the same solar and food gifts to career and authority matters, since Sun is exalted there.

classical_check: Red for Mars and Sun things for Aries are consistent with standard karakas; the gift list is his own.

hindi: दो नंबर राशि होती है घी की शुक्र की कपड़े की सुगंध की द्रव्य की कपड़ा लत्ता कोई गर्ल्स का ब्लाइंड स्कूल है वहां पर आप दे सकते हैं
says: If the sign number is 2 (Taurus), give Venus items such as ghee, cloth, perfume and liquids, for example clothes at a girls' blind school.

hindi: तीन नंबर राशि है तो बुध का दे सकते हैं आप हरी चीजें दें हरे रंग का तेल दे सकते हैं मूंग की दाल दे सकते हैं आप स्टेशनरी का सारा साजो
says: If the sign number is 3 (Gemini), give Mercury items: green things, green-coloured oil, moong dal and stationery supplies.
cells_derived_method: Gemini is Mercury-ruled, so green, pulses and writing goods fit; his sign 3 list also brings in Rahu items in the next sentences.

Derived, not said by him: Gemini on the 10th would suit trade-linked gifts such as money or accounts supplies for career blocks.

classical_check: Mercury karakas (green, moong, stationery) are standard.

hindi: सामान दे सकते हैं रेजगारी दे सकते हैं रुपया भी दे सकते हैं
says: For the same sign 3, loose coins and rupee money can also be given to students, extending the Mercury gifts to money.
cells_derived_method: Mercury is the planet of trade and counting, so cash and coins carry across to other Mercury-ruled signs, such as Virgo.

hindi: इसी तीन नंबर के अंदर आप चाय पत्ती दे सकते हैं यह राहु उच्च जाता है यहां चाय पत्ती का सामान दे

hindi: रॉकेट की तरह जिंदगी है आपकी आप कपना भी नहीं कर सकते क्या कार्यक्रम बनेगा मजा आ जाएगा

says: Also under sign 4, give yellow things, turmeric and spices, which are Jupiter-coloured items.

hindi: पांच नंबर की राशि हो गई सूर्य आटा ही दे दो वजन के बराबर यही बहुत बढ़िया काम कर दोगे कमाल

hindi: आप बेसन दे सकते हो पीला दे सकते हो य लाल रंग की चीज दे सकते हो मूंग की दाल चने की दाल दे सकते हो नमक होता है ये पीले रंग का नमकीन दे सकते हो

hindi: दुनिया भर का बेसन का गाठिया वगैरह नमकीन आता है छ नंबर राशि यही राहु महाराज की हो गई चाय पत्ती दे दो सबसे आसान

hindi: सात नंबर शनि शुक्र का सामान भी दे सकते हो सफेद कपड़ा काला कपड़ा भी दे सकते हो कोई मेटल की लोहे की चीज लगा दो आप जाकर के किसी स्कूल के अंदर

hindi: आठ नंबर राशि हो गई आपकी यह भी मंगल के समान ही चलेगा सारा का सारा सूर्य

hindi: अगर राशि एक नंबर के लगन में 12 एक और दो काम कर रही है तीनों कर रही है तो यहां तीन भी करेगी चार भी करेगी और पांच भी करेगी और य चार भी करेगी पांच भी करेगी छह भी करेगी

hindi: ऐसा कभी नहीं हो सकता कि सिंगल राशि होगी ऐसा हो ही नहीं सकता कि एक ही राशि काम कर रही है दो राशि तो मिनिमम करेंगी
