ambiguity: The sentence starts at the end of the previous chunk ('कुछ बेसन का'); the sweet is taken as the Mars item he names next.
classical_check: Gram flour as a Jupiter item is standard; the rest is his own.

gist: The child is delighted at getting chocolate today and the show goes on; light remark.
A listener asks whether coffee counts as an eating item.

hindi: कॉफी का कोई लेनदेन नहीं है ये है ना मंगल मीठा चॉकलेट दो
says: Coffee has no connection to this rule; the item to give is Mars's sweet chocolate.
ambiguity: This contrasts with the lagna 3 case where black coffee was allowed; he does not reconcile them.
classical_check: Silent; sweet as Mars is his own mapping.

hindi: खाने की पहनने की चीज स्टेशनरी कपड़े ये सब एक ही कैटेगरी में आते है मतलब इनसे रिलेटेड काम हम करेंगे तो फोथ हाउस की एक्टिवेशन हो रही है
says: Food, wearables, stationery and clothes all fall in one category, so working with any of them activates the 4th house.
cells_derived_method: The 4th box is the one being activated, so the sign on it decides which planet's colour and items must be right.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Gemini on the 4th would make green items and stationery the key choices.
Derived, not said by him: Sagittarius on the 4th would make yellow and book-related items the key choices.

ambiguity: 'फोथ हाउस' is the English 'fourth house'.
classical_check: The 4th as home, comfort and basic education is classical; the category is his own.

hindi: उस दिन पेपर देने जा रहे हो जिस दिन काम के टेंडर के लिए जा रहे हो उस दिन वहां एक्टिवेट हो रहा है इंटरव्यू के लिए जा रहे हो टेंडर के लिए जा रहे हो
says: The same activation happens on any day you go for an exam, a business tender or an interview, so the same colour and item rules apply on those days.
cells_derived_method: The rule applies to any day an evaluation event falls, and the colours follow the box-sign planets as for exams.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said by him: Aries on the 4th would make red the colour to wear for an interview day.
Derived, not said by him: Libra on the 4th would bar orange for a tender day, as for exam days.

ambiguity: The sentence is loose; the activation of the 4th is the link he draws.
classical_check: Silent; extending exam rules to interviews and tenders is his own.

gist: Dark joke about going to die, with 'marriage and death' and 'that is how it happens'.
Quips that wise people just bow to souls and nothing more.
Says a small point was missed and that they will go back to the sign 7 case.

hindi: यहां एक सिचुएशन है जिसमें चार नंबर था सात था और आठ था दूसरी सिचुएशन है जिसमें पांच था आठ था और नौ था
says: He sets up two worked examples for an exam-going student: in the first the relevant sign numbers are 4, 7 and 8 (Cancer, Libra, Scorpio); in the second they are 5, 8 and 9 (Leo, Scorpio, Sagittarius). The pick of what to eat, wear or carry on paper day will be made from these number sets.
cells_derived_method: none; this only names the two example sets. What the numbers refer to (signs occupied, signs of key houses) is not stated in this slice.
ambiguity: Not said whether 4,7,8 and 5,8,9 are signs or house numbers or which houses the signs belong to; later sentences call them rashi, so signs is the likelier reading.
classical_check: Classical texts are silent on picking food or colour by sign sets like this; it is his own method.

hindi: अब यहां पर प्रॉब्लम क्या आ रही है हमारे पास आठ नंबर दो जगह मिल रहा है
says: He points out a clash between the two example sets: number 8 (Scorpio) turns up in both, so the same sign cannot tell the two cases apart and the do/don't advice built on it overlaps.
cells_derived_method: A shared sign between two sets means any colour or food rule keyed to that sign applies identically in both sets, so the other numbers (4,7 versus 5,9) must carry the difference. Scorpio is Mars-ruled in his scheme (Uranus is also named for it).

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Scorpio sitting in the 8th house is common to both sets, so its Mars-flavoured colour rule would be the same for both students.
Derived, not said: Scorpio in the 4th (education) house gives the same shared-sign overlap, with the education house adding weight to Mars colours.

ambiguity: Whether eight means sign Scorpio or the 8th house is not clear from the caption.
classical_check: Silent; classical texts do not use a shared-number overlap this way.

hindi: ये होता है चंद्रमा पेपर वाले दिन ऐसा बच्चा सुबह चावल दूध पानी चावल की बनी कोई चीज दूध वाइट बिल्कुल नहीं और पानी पिए ही ना
says: For this kind of student on exam day, the morning must have no Moon items: no rice or rice dishes, no milk, nothing white, and not even water. These are Moon things and they will switch the Moon on.
cells_derived_method: none; he applies it to the sign set he just gave, where the Moon must stay off. In a chart where Moon rules or sits in a helpful exam house the same food would be neutral or helpful.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Moon-ruled Cancer in the 4th house would make the Moon strong for studies, so this avoidance is a rule only for sets where the Moon hurts, not a general ban.
Derived, not said: with Moon exalted in Taurus in the 9th house the same white food might support luck for the exam, which is the opposite of his rule here.

ambiguity: Why the Moon is harmful for this set is not stated in this slice.
classical_check: Moon karakatva for rice, milk, white things and water agrees with classical tables; the exam-day avoidance is his own practice.

hindi: तो क्या ले चंद्रमा एक्टिवेट अगर हो गया पेपर देते टाइम भयंकर थकेगा उबासियां आएंगी गारंटी है
says: If the Moon gets activated by those foods, the child will become badly tired while writing the paper and keep yawning; he says this is guaranteed. This is a claim from his practice, not a measured result.
cells_derived_method: none; effect is stated for the Moon being switched on under this sign set, not for other charts.
classical_check: Moon gives sleepiness and sluggishness in some texts, but a food-triggered guarantee is not classical.

hindi: अब उसको करना क्या है लौंग इलायची तुलसी केसर सौफ कुछ भी उसके पानी के अंदर जरा सा डाल के रखो और वही पानी वो पिए पेपर देने तक
says: Remedy: put a little clove, cardamom, tulsi, saffron or fennel (any one) into his drinking water and let him drink only that water until he finishes the paper, so that plain water does not switch the Moon on.
cells_derived_method: none; same remedy for the sign sets where the Moon must be kept off.
ambiguity: Fennel is allowed here as a water flavour but later he forbids eating green fennel in sign 4; the two contexts differ.
classical_check: Silent; spice-water remedy is his own.

hindi: पेपर देने तक उसको पेपर देने तक जूस पी सकता है कुछ और ले सकता है लस्सी नहीं पिलाना वाइट सफेद बर्फी ना खा ले दही चाट के जा मेरे बच्चे ना नेट एटल नास पिट जाएगा उसका
says: Until the paper is over he may have juice or other things, but no lassi, no white barfi and no curd; if he goes with curd the NET exam will be ruined. White and milk-based foods stay out.
cells_derived_method: none; applies to the Moon-off sign set.
ambiguity: NET is a national eligibility test; caption has garbled words after it, so the outcome claim is read loosely.
classical_check: Curd and milk sweets belong to Moon or Venus in classical karakatva; the exam-ruin claim is his tradition.

hindi: और उसको वैसा ही लेना लिम का पी ले कोल्ड ड्रिंक पी ले बच्चे की तो पार्टी हो गई
says: Allowed instead: a Limca-type lemon cold drink or any cold drink. He jokes that the child gets a party, so non-white fizzy drinks are fine on paper day for this set.
ambiguity: Limca is read from the caption word for the brand; a clear lemon drink is the likely sense.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: Garbled line about not doing something to Mars or to anyone; meaning cannot be recovered.

hindi: करो चंद्रमा को ऑन मत कर देना वाइट नहीं आना चाहिए यह ध्यान देना बहुत ज्यादा जरूरी है
says: He repeats the key point: do not switch the Moon on, nothing white may enter the exam-day routine, and this must be watched very carefully.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब य हो गया आ यह हो गया 11 यह 12 तो ना पीला आएगा यहां और ना हरा ये दो रंग नहीं आएंगे
says: For the set where signs 11 and 12 (Aquarius, Pisces) are the relevant ones, neither yellow nor green may be used; those two colours are out.
cells_derived_method: Colours follow planets: yellow is Jupiter, green is Mercury. Keyed to the sign pair, not to house, so the same ban would hold whichever house the pair occupies.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Aquarius in the 4th house with Pisces next in the 5th; both education houses, so he would bar Jupiter yellow and Mercury green items for the exam.
Derived, not said: Pisces in the 9th house is Jupiter's own sign, so banning yellow looks odd and shows his colour rule is not simply the sign lord.

ambiguity: Not clear whether 11 and 12 are signs or houses, and why Jupiter and Mercury are hostile here is not given.
classical_check: Differs from classical thinking, where Jupiter in his own sign Pisces would be supportive; this is his own colour system.

hindi: य मंगल का कलर आ सकता है यहां पर केतु राहु ग्रे कलर आ सकते हैं ग्रे कलर सिल्वर कलर ग्रे सिल्वर
says: In that same set the Mars colour (red) is allowed, and the grey colours of Rahu and Ketu, grey and silver, are also allowed.
cells_derived_method: Opposite of the banned colours: Mars red and the shadow-planet greys stay usable, so a student here is told to carry red or grey items instead of yellow or green.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Aquarius in the 10th house; grey or silver pen and red cover are the permitted choices, which also suit Saturn's sign.
Derived, not said: Pisces in the 12th house; Ketu-grey items are allowed since Pisces is also linked to Ketu in his scheme.

ambiguity: Same sign versus house doubt as the previous sentence.
classical_check: Rahu grey and Mars red agree with common colour karakatva; usage by sign is his own.

hindi: यह कलर्स भी जो कलर हमें जानने जरूरी है पहले तो सूर्य ऑरेंज
says: He says the planet colours must be known first, and starts the list: the Sun's colour is orange.
cells_derived_method: none; a planet to colour mapping.
classical_check: Agrees: Sun is given orange or red-orange in many colour lists.

hindi: राहु ब्लू ग्रे सिल्वर इसमें मतभेद है थोड़ी से कलर की मिक्सिंग होती है
says: Rahu's colours are blue, grey and silver; he admits there is disagreement among practitioners and a little overlap of colours between planets.
ambiguity: Which shade belongs to Rahu and which overlaps with another planet is left open.
classical_check: Rahu is often smoky or dark blue in classical lists; silver is usually Moon, so this overlap is real.

hindi: पीलेपन में लगी हुई मटम मिट्टी भी केतु की होती है
says: A yellowish, muddy earth colour belongs to Ketu, not to Jupiter's clean yellow.
ambiguity: The word read as muddy colour (matam) is a guess from the caption.
classical_check: Ketu gets variegated or smoky shades classically; earthy yellow is his own assignment.

gist: He says going into all colour details would become too complicated and confusing for the audience, so he stops there.

hindi: तो यहां केतु के कलर ले लो केतु का साजो सामान ले लो अपर पॉकेट के अंदर आप यह पहन लो अ प लाल रंग रख लो
says: For this set he suggests taking Ketu's colours and Ketu's items, putting them in the upper pocket or wearing them, and also keeping something red with the student.
cells_derived_method: none; remedy is for the sign set discussed just before (2 and 12 style sets).
ambiguity: Which numbers this applies to is unclear; a following sentence lists 12, 1, 2, 3/4 as an example.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: लाइक वाइज आप 12 एक दोती चार नंबर यहां है ये एग्जांपल है दूसरे भाव से भी हम कर सकते हैं
says: The same method works for other sets such as 12, 1, 2 and 3 or 4; this is just one example, and he adds that it can also be done from the second house.
cells_derived_method: The method generalises to any number set and to a house counted from another house, so the colour table could be rebuilt from the 2nd-house viewpoint as well as the sign viewpoint.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Taurus in the 2nd house, the speech and family house, would let the same pocket-colour method be run from there.
Derived, not said: Gemini in the 12th house is one possible case of the 12-1-2 style set he names.

ambiguity: Digits 12, 1, 2, 3/4 are partly garbled, and he mixes sign numbers with the word house.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: चार नंबर यहां पॉकेट के अंदर पीली चीज रख लो य यहां आ जाएगी य इफेक्ट आ जाएगा इसका पीले का तो बृहस्पति ऑन हो जाता है
says: For number 4 (Cancer), keep something yellow in the pocket; yellow switches Jupiter on, and Jupiter is exalted in Cancer so the effect will come through.
cells_derived_method: Jupiter is exalted in Cancer, so a yellow remedy has support in this sign. In other signs Jupiter's yellow may help less or clash with the colour bans listed for those signs.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Cancer in the 4th house puts the exalted-Jupiter sign on the education house, so yellow in the pocket is at its strongest.
Derived, not said: Cancer in the 10th house; yellow supports work and status by exalted Jupiter, which is a different use from studies.

ambiguity: Number 4 is taken as the sign Cancer since he calls it a rashi later.
classical_check: Jupiter exalted in Cancer is classical; yellow for Jupiter agrees; the pocket remedy is his own.

hindi: बृहस्पति पढ़ाई का देवता है ऑटोमेटिक गुडगुड कर देगा
says: Jupiter is the deity or karaka of studies, so once Jupiter is switched on the exam will go well by itself.
classical_check: Agrees: Jupiter is the main karaka of learning and higher education.

hindi: न हो गया 12 हो गया एक ना काला चलेगा ना सफेद चलेगा ना हरा यह कलर्स आउट है
says: For the set 12 and 1 (Pisces, Aries), black, white and green are all out; none of those colours should be used.
cells_derived_method: Black is Saturn, white is Moon, green is Mercury, so the set rules out those three planets. Keyed to signs, so house placement does not change which colours are barred.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Pisces in the 5th house; black, white and green pens or clothes are avoided for the paper.
Derived, not said: Aries in the 1st house makes the set land on the self house; the same three colours stay out.

ambiguity: Digits garbled; 12 and 1 read as Pisces and Aries.
classical_check: Silent; his own colour table.

hindi: 10 एक दो सेम ना काला ना हरा ना ऑरेंज यही कार्यक्रम
says: For the set 10, 1, 2 (Capricorn, Aries, Taurus) it is the same idea: no black, no green and no orange; the programme is the same.
cells_derived_method: Black is Saturn, green Mercury, orange Sun; banned for this set.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Capricorn in the 10th house, Saturn's own sign in the career house; black stays out even though it is the sign lord's colour.
Derived, not said: Taurus in the 2nd house; Venus-ruled, with green, black and orange avoided on exam day.

ambiguity: Digits garbled; could be 10, 11, 12 or 10, 1, 2.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: यहां पर 11 दो तीन ना सिल्वर चलेगा ना ग्रे चलेगा ना यहां पर ऑरेंज कलर चलेगा काला रंग दोनों के लिए बढ़िया बहुत अच्छा
says: For the set 11, 2, 3 (Aquarius, Taurus, Gemini), silver, grey and orange do not work; black is very good for both of the remaining cases.
cells_derived_method: Silver and grey are Moon or Rahu colours, orange is the Sun. Black is Saturn, which is a friend of Mercury and Venus signs, so black is allowed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Aquarius in the 11th house, Saturn's sign; black is natural and good, orange and grey stay out.
Derived, not said: Gemini in the 3rd house, Mercury's sign; black is fine through Saturn-Mercury friendship, silver is not.

ambiguity: Which two cases black is good for is not clear.
classical_check: Saturn friendly to Mercury and Venus is classical; the colour bans are his own.

hindi: हरा रंग लो बुध के लिए बुध एक्टिवेट करो ग्रीन कलर बहुत
says: Where green is allowed, take green for Mercury and activate Mercury through it; green is very good for studies.
cells_derived_method: none; usable in sets where green is not banned.
classical_check: Mercury green and Mercury as intellect karaka agree with classical tables.

hindi: बढ़िया है इसकी राइट पॉकेट के अंदर बोलो पेन पन पेंसिल और वो डाल के रख बेटा
says: Green is excellent; put a green pen or pencil in the right pocket and keep it there throughout.
ambiguity: It is not clear whether the item must be green or just a pen or pencil.
classical_check: Silent; pocket side rules are his own.

hindi: पेंसिल का बहुत अच्छा इस्तेमाल होता है लेड होता है इसमें पेंसिल में राहु होता है
says: A pencil is very useful as a remedy tool because its lead stands for Rahu, so a pencil can bring Rahu into the pocket.
ambiguity: He means graphite lead, called lead in Hindi usage.
classical_check: Classical lists give Rahu lead-like metals and dark minerals; pencil lead is his adaptation.

hindi: लेड इसकी राइट पॉकेट में लेड का आजकल अकेली भी मिलती है टचक टचक वाली पेंसिल होती है उसका लेड बक्स है जेब में डाल लो कोई कुछ नहीं है सिर्फ राइट पॉकेट में पड़ा रहेगा काम हो गया सारा
says: Practical tip: put just the lead in the right pocket; the click pencil leads sold in a small box will do, and simply lying in the pocket is enough to do the whole job.
classical_check: Silent.

gist: He points to a girl sitting behind and says she has been passing for four years.
He says she used to be unfit to study at all and her mother was ready to throw her out of the house.
He calls her up as a living example of how useless she had been, unable even to open a book.
He tells her to show her face to everyone, says she studies and passes now, and tells her to sit back.
He says a child should study at least a little, adding that it is a good thing.
He says this girl is his blessing and she passed by doing his remedies.
There are many such children; her mother is also his child and he gives her remedies as well.
He asks to look at the population of the country; filler before the next example.

hindi: यह हो गया दो यह है 12 यह तीन और यह चार यहां लाल नहीं आएगा और य य केतु के कलर नहीं आएंगे
says: For the set 2, 12, 3 and 4 (Taurus, Pisces, Gemini, Cancer), red cannot be used and Ketu's colours are also out.
cells_derived_method: Red is Mars, so Mars items stay off; Ketu earth or variegated colours also stay off. Since the set includes Cancer, where Mars is debilitated, a red ban fits.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Cancer in the 4th house, with Mars debilitated there; red is barred for the exam.
Derived, not said: Pisces in the 12th house is also a Ketu-linked sign in his scheme, so Ketu colours stay out.

ambiguity: Digit order 2, 12, 3, 4 is garbled.
classical_check: Mars debilitated in Cancer is classical; the colour ban is his own.

hindi: तो ये सुबह सुबह क्या करके जाए थोड़ी सी चाय पी के चला जाए चीनी ना डाले यह ध्यान रखना है
says: For that set, what should the student have in the morning? A little tea and then go, but without sugar, which must be remembered.
cells_derived_method: none; applies to the Taurus-Pisces-Gemini-Cancer set above.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: मंगलन नहीं करना चीनी नहीं डालनी फी चाय इसमें दूध नहीं होगा
says: Do not activate Mars, so no sugar in the tea. It will be plain tea with no milk.
ambiguity: Sugar is usually Venus, yet he ties it to Mars here; the caption word may mean something else.
classical_check: Differs: sugar is classically Venus, not Mars.

hindi: दूध आ जाने से चंद्रमा मिक्स हो गया राहू में बिकम अ प्रॉब्लम
says: If milk is added, the Moon gets mixed with Rahu (black tea is Rahu here), and that becomes a problem.
cells_derived_method: none; a blend rule: Moon plus Rahu in the same drink spoils the remedy.
classical_check: Moon with Rahu is the Grahan yoga idea, so mixing them as a problem agrees in spirit.

hindi: काली फी चाय नो दूध नो चीनी यह इसका काम हो गया
says: Summary of the morning drink: black tea with no milk and no sugar, and the student's job for that set is done.
classical_check: Silent.

hindi: अब यहां पर हम हरी सौफ क्यों नहीं खा सकते बुद्ध यहां चार नंबर में शत्रु है बुध नहीं कर सकते
says: Why can we not eat green fennel here? Because Mercury is an enemy in number 4 (Cancer), so Mercury cannot be activated for this set.
cells_derived_method: Mercury treats the Moon as an enemy, so Moon-ruled Cancer is an enemy sign for Mercury. In friend or own signs of Mercury green would be allowed instead.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Cancer in the 4th house puts Mercury in an enemy sign on the education house, so green fennel is withheld.
Derived, not said: Gemini in the 3rd house is Mercury's own sign, so green would be safe there, the opposite of the Cancer ruling.

classical_check: Agrees: Mercury regards the Moon as an enemy in the planetary friendship table.

hindi: इसलिए हरे रंग की स्टेशनरी नॉट गुड ब्लू ले सकते हैं यहां दिखेगा हरा रंग दिख रहा है लेकिन ब्लू ले सकते हैं हरा नहीं
says: For the same reason, green stationery is not good in this case; blue stationery may be used. Even if a green option is visible on the table, take blue and not green.
cells_derived_method: Green is Mercury, blue is Rahu in his list; in Cancer the first is blocked and the second allowed.

derived_examples.reading: Derived, not said: Cancer in the 4th house; blue pen and pad are allowed, green ones are not.
Derived, not said: Cancer in the 7th house would keep the same sign-based colour rule even though the house is a partnership house.

hindi: सकते हैं हरा नहीं इसलिए बुध यहां हरी सोफ खाके जाओगे पंगा हो जाएगा
